item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae Orders 'Suspension of All Democratic Party Candidate Campaigns' After Hanwha Aerospace Incident (정청래, 한화에어로 사고에 ‘전국 민주당 후보 유세 중단’ 지시)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae Orders 'Suspension of All Democratic Party Candidate Campaigns' After Hanwha Aerospace Incident (정청래, 한화에어로 사고에 ‘전국 민주당 후보 유세 중단’ 지시)

Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, issued an emergency directive on the 1st to suspend campaigning for all local election candidates and their campaign teams nationwide following an explosion at Hanwha Aerospace in Daejeon. <<> The Democratic Party stated in a notice after the incident that "Leader Jeong has issued an urgent directive to all Democratic Party candidates and campaign teams across the country to halt the use of campaign songs and choreography in connection with the Hanwha Aerospace accident in Daejeon." <<> Earlier that day, Leader Jeong shared an article on Facebook about the explosion at Hanwha Aerospace's Daejeon plant, saying, "I sincerely hope there is no major damage," and urged "the relevant authorities to do their utmost for swift rescue and firefighting efforts." <<> On the same day, at a campaign event for Chungcheongbuk-do Governor candidate Shin Yong-han and Goesan County candidate Lee Cha-young in Goesan-gun, Chungcheongbuk-do, Leader Jeong stated, "A major accident has occurred at Hanwha Aerospace in Daejeon. I have issued an urgent notice to all Democratic Party campaign teams nationwide to suspend the use of campaign songs and choreography. I ask those actively campaigning to follow the central party's guidelines and remain calm. I came here to keep my promise (to attend the event), but I will deliver my message and leave." <<> Leader Jeong further said, "It's said that one human life is as precious as the entire universe. With an estimated six casualties, still unconfirmed, and lives hanging in the balance amid the flames, we cannot proceed with our campaign in the usual manner. The state's primary duty and most important responsibility is to protect the lives and safety of its people." <<> According to fire authorities, the explosion occurred that morning at the Hanwha Aerospace plant in Oesam-dong, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 1일 대전에서 한화에어로스페이스 폭발 사고가 발생하자, 전국 지방선거 민주당 후보와 캠프에 유세 중단을 긴급 지시했다.)

item.title: Controversy over ‘Kiss’ Demand on Baby at DP Campaign Rally: "Child Exploitation Electioneering" (野 민주당 유세 중 아기에 ‘뽀뽀’ 강요 논란에 “아동 착취 선거마케팅”)
item.description:
Controversy over ‘Kiss’ Demand on Baby at DP Campaign Rally: "Child Exploitation Electioneering" (野 민주당 유세 중 아기에 ‘뽀뽀’ 강요 논란에 “아동 착취 선거마케팅”)

Amid controversy over Woo Hyung-chan, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Yangcheon District Mayor, telling a baby to "give a kiss" during a campaign rally for the June 3 local elections, the People Power Party on the 1st called for the Democratic Party to "stop child exploitation electioneering." <<> Park Choong-kwon, the senior deputy spokesperson and head of the public relations team for the People Power Party's central election committee, issued a statement that morning, saying, "The Yangcheon District candidate's shameless demand for a kiss is not a simple mistake but outright violence." <<> He added, "Is the DNA of Busan candidate Ha Jung-woo and Representative Jung Chung-rae's 'oppa coercion' flowing into Yangcheon as well?" and "At this rate, we can't help but suspect the Democratic Party's structural lack of gender sensitivity. Are they willing to trample on a child's rights just for votes?" <<> Furthermore, he said, "What's more serious is the attitude of Seoul Mayor candidate Jung Won-oh, who was present at the scene," noting, "Even though Jung was the one holding the child, he didn't stop the demand for a kiss." The senior deputy spokesperson added, "This is why Jung draws criticism of being 'incompetent' or an 'avatar.'" <<> Park Sung-hoon, another senior deputy spokesperson for the party, also said in a statement that day, "This bizarre old-style politics of using children as tools for 'begging for votes' reveals the true face of the Democratic Party's so-called 'children's rights.'" <<> He said, "Following Representative Jung Chung-rae's absurd request for a young girl to 'call me oppa' during a campaign stop in Busan, now Woo Hyung-chan, the Democratic Party candidate for Yangcheon District Mayor, is caught demanding a kiss from a baby he met on the campaign trail," adding, "The Democratic Party's electioneering is sinking to a level that's hard to watch." <<> The senior deputy spokesperson stated, "The Democratic Party, which has loudly advocated for 'children's rights' on the surface, has now been fully exposed for treating children as mere props for image-making and tools for hypocritical 'show-communication' on the election stage," and "We strongly urge the Democratic Party to immediately stop this hypocritical 'show-communication' politics that uses children as fronts and to repent gravely." <<> Previously, the day before, Woo Hyung-chan, the Democratic Party candidate for Yangcheon District Mayor, said to a baby held in the arms of Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul Mayor, at a campaign rally in Mok-dong, Yangcheon District, "One kiss," and "Give a kiss." Lim Se-eun, a senior deputy spokesperson for the Democratic Party, who was standing nearby, blocked the attempt. The scene was captured on camera and spread online. <<> As the controversy grew, Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul Mayor, met with reporters after a rally at Seoul Station that day and said, "We handled the issue at the scene," adding, "But I feel a deep sense of responsibility that this kind of problem shouldn't recur." Woo also posted on his blog the previous day, apologizing, saying, "There's no excuse for my careless and thoughtless words and actions." (6·3 지방선거 유세 중 우형찬 더불어민주당 양천구청장 후보가 아기에게 ‘뽀뽀해’라고 말해 논란을 빚은 가운데 1일 국민의힘이 “민주당은 아동 착취 선거 마케팅을 중단하라”고 했다.)

item.title: People Power Party pushes ‘Jung Won-oh Prevention Act’… Aims to prevent TV debate avoidance (국힘 ‘정원오 방지법’ 추진…TV토론 회피 막는다)
item.description:
People Power Party pushes ‘Jung Won-oh Prevention Act’… Aims to prevent TV debate avoidance (국힘 ‘정원오 방지법’ 추진…TV토론 회피 막는다)

The People Power Party announced on the 1st that it would pursue legislation targeting Democratic Party of Korea Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh and Incheon mayoral candidate Park Chan-dae as party policy. At the same time, it appealed to voters, acknowledging that it had fallen short in the past. (국민의힘이 더불어민주당 정원오 서울시장 후보와 박찬대 인천시장 후보를 겨냥한 입법을 당론으로 추진하겠다고 1일 밝혔다. 그러면서 국민의힘이 그간 부족했다며 유권자들을 향해 호소했다.)

People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok held a press briefing on the June 3 local elections at the National Assembly that morning and stated, “We will pursue the ‘Jung Won-oh Prevention Act’ and the ‘Three Acts to Prevent Park Chan-dae’s 22nd-cousin Fraud’ as party policy,” adding, “We will strive to judge Democratic Party candidates who avoid debates and use false backgrounds to undermine the elections, and to establish a fair election culture.” (국민의힘 송언석 원내대표는 이날 오전 국회에서 6·3 지방선거 대국민 호소 기자간담회를 열고 “‘정원오 방지법’과 ‘박찬대 22촌 사칭 사기 방지 3법’을 당론으로 추진하겠다”며 “토론을 회피하고 거짓 이력으로 선거를 허탈하게 만드는 민주당 후보자들을 심판하고 정정당당한 선거 문화를 정착시키기 위해 노력하겠다”고 말했다.)

The so-called ‘Jung Won-oh Prevention Act,’ which the People Power Party is promoting, involves amending the Public Official Election Act to mandate that provincial and metropolitan government candidates hold at least three debates. Previously, Candidate Jung had avoided debates requested by the People Power Party and the Reform Party’s Seoul mayoral candidates, holding his first and only debate at 11 p.m. on the 27th of last month, just five hours before early voting began. (국민의힘이 추진하는 이른바 ‘정원오 방지법’은 시도지사 후보의 토론을 최소 3회 이상으로 의무화하는 방향으로 공직선거법을 개정하는 내용이다. 앞서 정 후보는 국민의힘과 개혁신당 서울시장 후보가 요구하는 토론을 회피해 오다 사전 투표 개시 5시간 전인 지난달 27일 밤 11시에 처음이자 마지막 토론회를 한 번 가졌다.)

Floor leader Song explained, “The Three Acts to Prevent Park Chan-dae’s Fraud are amendments to the Public Official Election Act, the Public Service Ethics Act, and the Act on the Honorable Treatment of Persons of Meritorious Service to the Independence of Korea.” He stated that these measures require candidates to specify their exact familial relationship and kinship distance when registering, to prevent them from deceiving voters. “They include provisions to prevent current public officials from fabricating blood relations, and to penalize acts that falsely tarnish the names and honor of independence activists,” he said. (송 원내대표는 “박찬대 사기방지 3법은 공직선거법, 공직자윤리법, 독립유공자예우에 관한 법률 개정안”이라고 했다. 선거 후보자가 등록할 때 구체적인 촌수와 관계를 명시하도록 해 유권자를 기만하지 못하도록 하는 내용을 담았다고 설명했다. 그는 “재직 중인 공직자들이 혈연관계를 허위 조작하지 못하도록 하고, 독립운동가의 이름과 명예를 허위로 더럽히는 행위를 처벌하는 내용을 포함했다”고 밝혔다.)

He added, “Candidate Park has introduced himself in official settings as the ‘grandson (via daughter) of an independence activist’ or ‘descendant of an independence activist,’” and “Claiming to be a descendant of an independence activist based on a 22nd-cousin relationship damages the honor of the true descendants.” (그는 “박 후보가 공식 석상에서 자신을 ‘독립유공자의 외손’ 또는 ‘독립운동가 후손’으로 소개해 왔다”며 “22촌을 가지고 독립유공자 후손이라고 얘기하는 것은 진짜 후손들에 대한 명예를 실추시키는 것”이라고 했다.)

With two days left until the election, the People Power Party appealed to voters that day, saying, “We are well aware that you see the People Power Party as falling far short. We apologize and reflect on this,” and asking, “Please at least protect the Republic of Korea, which stands at a crossroads.” (국민의힘은 선거를 이틀 앞둔 이날 “국민의힘이 많이 부족하다고 보시는 것을 잘 알고 있다. 송구하게 생각하고 반성한다”며 “바람 앞에 놓인 대한민국만은 지켜달라”고 호소했다.)

Floor leader Song argued for the need to check the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party, stating, “Shouldn’t you press the control button at least once for the ruling party, which cannot contain its overflowing power and is intoxicated by the taste of power?” (송 원내대표는 “넘치는 힘을 주체하지 못하고 권력의 맛에 도취한 집권 세력에게 제어 버튼 한 번은 눌러주셔야 하지 않느냐”며 이재명 정부와 더불어민주당에 대한 견제가 필요하다고 주장했다.)

Previously, on the 21st of last month, Floor leader Song also appealed to voters, saying, “We are approaching this election with a spirit of atonement and responsibility. We will humble ourselves further. We will reflect more fiercely.” (앞서 송 원내대표는 지난달 21일에도 “이번 선거를 속죄와 책임의 마음으로 치르고 있다. 더 낮아지겠다. 더 치열하게 반성하겠다”면서 유권자에게 호소했다.)

item.title: "I Will Go with Common-Sense Politicians" – People Power Party Candidates at Han Dong-hoon's Rally (“상식적 정치인과 함께 갈 것” 한동훈 유세장에 나온 국힘 후보들)
item.description:
"I Will Go with Common-Sense Politicians" – People Power Party Candidates at Han Dong-hoon's Rally (“상식적 정치인과 함께 갈 것” 한동훈 유세장에 나온 국힘 후보들)

People Power Party candidates appeared on a campaign truck at the rally held by independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, who is running in the by-election for the Buk-gu Gap district of Busan. Spotting them during his speech, Han declared, "I will go with common-sense politicians of the People Power Party." (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보의 집중유세에 국민의힘 후보들이 유세트럭이 등장했다. 유세 도중 이들을 발견한 한 후보는 “상식적인 국민의힘 정치인과 함께 갈 것”이라고 연설했다.)

People Power Party district council candidates Park Seong-jin and Kim Jang-su, running in the Buk-gu 'Na' electoral district, appeared near Sookdeung Station in Deokcheon-dong, Busan, on the 31st at Han's rally. The People Power Party candidates, aboard a red campaign truck, listened to the speeches among Han's supporters, who were dressed in white. (부산 북구 ‘나’선거구에 출마한 국민의힘 박성진·김장수 구의원 후보는 지난 31일 부산 덕천동 숙등역 인근에서 열린 한 후보 집중 유세장에 모습을 보였다. 붉은색 유세트럭에 올라탄 국민의힘 후보들은 하얀색 옷을 갖춰 입은 한 후보 지지자들 사이에서 연설을 경청했다.)

At the event, Han pointed to the People Power Party district council candidates and said, "Look over there. Don't the People Power Party politicians I will return to also agree with conservative reconstruction and the development of Buk-gu?" He added, "The Democratic Party and the Jang Dong-hyuk faction of party power are pressuring me, but I am not alone. I will exclude no one," and stated, "I will go even with common-sense People Power Party politicians who seek to rebuild conservatism." (이 자리에서 한 후보는 국민의힘 구의원 후보들을 가리켜 “여러분 저기를 보시라. 제가 돌아갈 국민의힘 정치인들도 보수 재건과 북구 발전에 공감하고 있지 않느냐”고 했다. 그러면서 “민주당과 장동혁 당권파가 압박하지만 외롭지 않다. 저는 그 누구도 배제하지 않을 것”이라며 “보수를 재건하겠다는 상식적인 국민의힘 정치인과도 함께 갈 것”이라고 했다.)

On the 24th of last month, Han also said, "There are many People Power Party candidates who hope for conservative reconstruction based on the Constitution, facts, and common sense," and expressed, "I hope the People Power Party candidates joining the conservative reconstruction will do their best and perform well." (한 후보는 지난달 24일에도 “헌법, 사실, 상식에 기반한 보수 재건을 바라는 많은 국민의힘 후보들이 계신다”라며 “보수 재건에 동참하는 국민의힘 후보들이 더욱더 힘내서 선전하기를 바란다”라고 했다.)

On the same day, People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik for the Buk-gu Gap by-election in Busan met with former President Lee Myung-bak in Haeundae-gu, Busan. Park said, "The number games under the guise of opinion polls, all sorts of scheming and manipulation, if bad politics that distorts public sentiment wears the mask of conservatism, conservatism will fall into a quagmire again," and added, "The hearts of Buk-gu residents who are reaching out to me—that is the true public sentiment." (같은 날 국민의힘 박민식 부산 북갑 보궐선거 후보는 부산 해운대구에서 이명박 전 대통령과 만났다. 박 후보는 “여론조사라는 이름의 숫자 놀음. 온갖 공작과 조작, 민심 왜곡하는 나쁜 정치가 보수의 탈을 쓴다면 보수는 다시 수렁에 빠질 것”이라며 “제 손을 잡아주시는 북구 주민 여러분의 마음. 그것이 진짜 민심”이라고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 28th of last month, Park visited Gijang in Busan to accompany former President Park Geun-hye for a campaign support event. At that event, former President Park said of candidate Park Min-shik for Buk-gu Gap, "If we give Park the opportunity to serve, he will steadfastly protect this country." (박 후보는 이보다 앞선 지난달 28일엔 부산 기장을 찾아 박근혜 전 대통령의 지원유세에 동행했다. 이 자리에서 박 전 대통령은 민식 부산 북갑 후보에 대해 “박 후보에게 봉사할 기회를 주면 이 나라를 잘 지켜나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Democracy Party: "For the Success of the Lee Government, Support Kim Yong-nam" Innovation Party: "Jo Kuk Will Uphold Pyeongtaek's Pride" (민주 “李정부 성공 위해 김용남” 혁신당 “평택 자존심 지켜낼 조국”)
item.description:
Democracy Party: "For the Success of the Lee Government, Support Kim Yong-nam" Innovation Party: "Jo Kuk Will Uphold Pyeongtaek's Pride" (민주 “李정부 성공 위해 김용남” 혁신당 “평택 자존심 지켜낼 조국” )

On the 1st, two days before the main voting for the June 3 local elections and parliamentary by-elections, the Democratic Party of Korea and the Jo Kuk Innovation Party each appealed to voters to cast their ballots for their respective candidates running in the Pyeongtaek-eul re-election. (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거 본투표를 이틀 앞둔 1일, 더불어민주당과 조국혁신당은 각각 경기 평택을 재선거에 출마한 자당 후보를 찍어달라며 유권자들에게 호소했다.)

From the Democratic Party, a group of lawmakers including Yoon Jong-gun, Lee Geon-tae, Lee Jae-gang, and Kim Nam-hee—forming the 'Kim Yong-nam Support Parliamentary Team'—visited Pyeongtaek and held a press conference, stating, "For the future of Pyeongtaek and the success of the Lee Jae-myung government, please rally support for Democratic Party candidate Kim." (민주당에선 윤종군·이건태·이재강·김남희 의원 등 ‘김용남 후보 지원 국회의원단’이 이날 평택을 찾아 기자회견을 열고 “평택 미래를 위해, 이재명 정부 성공을 위해 민주당 김 후보에게 힘을 모아 달라”고 했다.)

The lawmakers emphasized, "Pyeongtaek needs not a politician who only talks, but someone who can deliver real results," adding, "Candidate Kim is the person who can connect the central government, the National Assembly, Gyeonggi Province, and Pyeongtaek City to resolve local issues." They particularly stressed the need for a lawmaker who can collaborate with the central government for Pyeongtaek's development. "Major projects like KTX, GTX, and road expansions cannot be pushed forward by a single lawmaker alone," the team said. "Pyeongtaek City, Gyeonggi Province, and the central government must work together, and sometimes cooperation with lawmakers from neighboring regions is also necessary." (의원단은 “평택에는 말뿐인 정치인이 아니라, 실제 성과를 만들어낼 사람이 필요하다”면서 “중앙정부와 국회, 경기도와 평택시를 연결해 지역 현안을 풀어낼 사람이 바로 김 후보”라고 강조했다. 이들은 특히 평택 발전을 위해 중앙정부와 협력할 수 있는 국회의원이 필요하다고 했다. 의원단은 “KTX와 GTX, 도로망 확충 등 주요 사업은 국회의원 혼자 추진할 수 있는 일이 아니다”라면서 “평택시와 경기도, 중앙정부가 함께 움직여야 하고 때로는 인접 지역 국회의원들과도 협력해야 한다”고 했다.)

The team stated, "Pyeongtaek needs a Democratic Party lawmaker to work alongside President Lee Jae-myung, Gyeonggi Province Governor Choo Mi-ae, and Pyeongtaek Mayor Choi Won-yong," adding, "Candidate Kim is the nominee chosen by President Lee Jae-myung and nominated by the Democratic Party." (의원단은 “평택에는 이재명 대통령과 추미애 경기도지사, 최원용 평택시장과 함께 일할 민주당 국회의원이 필요하다”면서 “김 후보는 이재명 대통령이 선택하고, 민주당이 공천한 후보”라고 했다.)

In contrast, the Jo Kuk Innovation Party criticized Candidate Kim as "a seed of division within the democratic camp" and "a gift set of suspicions," urging support for Candidate Jo Kuk instead. (반면 조국혁신당은 김 후보를 “민주 진영 분열의 씨앗”, “의혹 종합 선물 세트”라고 비판하면서 조국 후보에게 힘을 모아달라고 했다.)

Lee Hae-min, Secretary General of the Jo Kuk Innovation Party, held a press conference at the National Assembly that day and said, "We will achieve victory through Jo Kuk, the real candidate who will uphold the pride of Pyeongtaek citizens and protect the true values of democracy," adding, "Please gather overwhelming support for the path where Pyeongtaek grows and the Lee Jae-myung government succeeds." (이해민 조국혁신당 사무총장은 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 “평택 시민의 자존심을 세우면서 민주주의의 진짜 가치를 지켜낼 진짜 후보, 조국을 통해 반드시 승리 이루겠다”면서 “평택이 커지고 이재명 정부가 성공하는 길에 압도적 지지를 모아달라”고 했다.)

Secretary General Lee responded to Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae's earlier remark that Candidate Jo should 'take off the Democratic Party mask,' saying, "The mask is the most fitting expression for Candidate Kim Yong-nam. It suits this chameleon-like former prosecutor candidate, who was with the People Power Party, then the Reform Party, and kept chasing power and nominations by shifting party affiliations." (이 사무총장은 전날 조승래 민주당 사무총장이 조 후보에게 ‘민주당 가면을 벗어라’고 한 데 대해 “가면은 김용남 후보에게 가장 어울리는 표현이다. 국민의힘이었다가 개혁신당이었다가, 이리저리 힘 좇고 공천 좇아 당적 쇼핑하던 카멜레온 같은 검사 출신 후보에게 어울리는 표현”이라고 맞받았다.)

Secretary General Lee added, "The leadership of the Democratic Party must not forget the values of political reform and integration that President Lee Jae-myung and the party promised to the people," stating, "The clear task for the Democratic Party leadership now is to make a decisive move regarding Candidate Kim and lead the entire democratic camp to victory." (이 사무총장은 “이재명 대통령과 민주당이 국민께 약속했던 정치 개혁과 통합의 가치를 민주당 지도부는 잊어서는 안 된다”면서 “지금 민주당 지도부가 해야 할 명확한 일은 김 후보에 대한 결단을 해서 민주 진영 전체의 승리를 이끌어내는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "The 'Three Prisoners' Yoon, Lee, and Park's re-emergence is an insult to the people... Let's send them into history" (정청래 “‘감옥 3인방’ 尹·李·朴 등판은 국민 무시...역사 속으로 보내자”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "The 'Three Prisoners' Yoon, Lee, and Park's re-emergence is an insult to the people... Let's send them into history" (정청래 “‘감옥 3인방’ 尹·李·朴 등판은 국민 무시...역사 속으로 보내자”)

Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, appealed to voters on the 1st regarding former presidents Lee Myung-bak, Park Geun-hye, and Yoon Suk-yeol, produced by the conservative camp, saying, "We must now send the 'three prisoners' into history," and "To achieve that, please vote for the Democratic Party's number 1 candidate alongside President Lee Jae-myung." <<> At a central election committee meeting held that morning at the campaign office of Park Soo-hyun, the Democratic Party's candidate for South Chungcheong Province governor in Cheonan, Jung stated, "The pre-election re-emergence of Yoon, Lee, and Park is an insult to the people," and made these remarks. <<> Jung said, "There are still forces dreaming of the revival of the ringleader of the insurrection, Yoon Suk-yeol, shouting 'Yoon Again'; former President Park Geun-hye, who was impeached by the Candlelight Revolution for state affairs abuse and went to prison; former President Lee Myung-bak, a symbol of corruption who went to prison for corruption—these 'three prisoners' are denying and shaking President Lee Jae-myung." <<> Jung stated, "The great fire of insurrection has been put out, but the embers of the insurrection are still stirring. If we fail to completely extinguish the embers of the insurrection, it could spread into a great fire again at any time. Even a fire that seems out must be watched," and added, "We must break away from the outdated forces of 'Yoon Again' and 'Lee Myung-bak & Park Geun-hye' and join hands with President Lee Jae-myung on the path of economic development, pragmatic diplomacy, and peace on the Korean Peninsula." <<> Regarding the early voting turnout for the June 3 local elections reaching a record high of 23.51%, Jung stated, "This astonishing turnout clearly proves how far removed the claims of those who tout the 'early voting fraud' theory and deceive the people are from public sentiment," and added, "The fervent early voting enthusiasm is a result of the heartfelt wishes of the people to completely purge the still-stirring insurrection forces and normalize the Republic of Korea." <<> He also said, "Voting is stronger than bullets. Power does not come from the barrel of a gun. It comes from the polling station," and urged, "Please exercise the spirit of popular sovereignty as stated in Article 1, Paragraph 2 of the Constitution: 'The sovereignty of the Republic of Korea resides in the people, and all power emanates from the people.'" <<> (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 1일 보수 진영이 배출한 이명박·박근혜·윤석열 전 대통령에 대해 “감옥 3인방을 이제 역사 속으로 보내야 한다”면서 “그러기 위해 이재명 대통령과 함께 하는 민주당 기호 1번에게 투표해달라”고 유권자들에게 호소했다.)

item.title: Opposition: "All Five Figures in the Daejang-dong Ring Released... 780 Billion Won Goes into Criminals' Pockets" (野 “대장동 일당 5인방 모두 풀려나...7800억 범죄자 호주머니에”)
item.description:
Opposition: "All Five Figures in the Daejang-dong Ring Released... 780 Billion Won Goes into Criminals' Pockets" (野 “대장동 일당 5인방 모두 풀려나...7800억 범죄자 호주머니에”)

The People Power Party (PPP) stated on the 1st, "While all five members of the Daejang-dong crime ring have ultimately been released, the Ministry of Justice has indefinitely suspended prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who investigated President Lee Jae-myung's North Korean remittance case, without any disciplinary action." The party announced it would launch an online petition campaign to halt attempts to discipline Prosecutor Park. (국민의힘은 1일 “대장동 범죄 일당 5인방이 결국 모두 풀려난 데 반해, 법무부는 이재명 대통령의 대북 송금 사건을 수사했던 박상용 검사를 징계도 없이 무기한 직무 정지시켰다”고 했다. 당은 이날 박 검사에 대한 징계 시도를 중단하기 위한 온라인 국민 탄원 서명 운동을 시작한다고 밝혔다.)

PPP floor leader Song Eon-seok said at a party meeting that morning, "780 billion won in criminal proceeds are set to go straight into the pockets of the criminals," adding, "Those who commit crimes live it up, while those who uncover crimes are punished—this is the current state of the Republic of Korea under the Lee Jae-myung regime." (송언석 국민의힘 원내대표는 이날 오전 당 회의에서 “범죄 수익 7800억원이 고스란히 범죄자들의 호주머니에 들어갈 예정”이라며 “범죄를 저지른 사람은 떵떵거리고 범죄를 파헤친 사람은 벌 받는 나라가 이재명 정권 대한민국의 현주소”라고 했다.)

He continued, "I hope the people will judge this arrogant authoritarian regime. The only way is through voting," and added, "I earnestly appeal to you to warn the Democratic Party of Korea's recklessness with your votes right now. If you don't issue a warning now, the Lee Jae-myung regime will push through a special prosecution for the cancellation of indictments." (이어 “(국민들이) 오만한 권위주의 정권을 심판해 주시길 바란다. 방법은 오직 투표”라며 “바로 지금 더불어민주당의 폭주에 투표로 경고해 주시기를 간곡히 호소드린다. 지금 경고를 내려주시지 않으면 이재명 정권은 공소 취소 특검을 밀어붙일 것”이라고 했다.)

The previous day, it was revealed that accountant Jeong Yeong-hak and lawyer Jeong Min-yong, who had been sentenced to prison terms at their first trial and detained in court for the 'Daejang-dong development corruption' case, were released on bail during their appeal trial. Following the release of Kim Man-bae, the major shareholder of Hwacheon Daeyu, Yoo Dong-gyu, former head of the planning division at Seongnam Urban Development Corporation, and lawyer Nam-wook—who were released after their detention periods expired last month—all five defendants in the Daejang-dong case are now undergoing their appeal trials without detention. (전날 ‘대장동 개발 비리’ 사건으로 1심에서 실형을 선고받고 법정 구속됐던 정영학 회계사와 정민용 변호사가 항소심 재판 중 보석으로 풀려난 사실이 알려졌다. 지난달 구속 기간 만료로 석방된 화천대유 대주주 김만배씨와 유동규 전 성남도시개발공사 기획본부장, 남욱 변호사에 이어 대장동 사건 피고인 5명이 전부 불구속 상태에서 항소심 재판을 받게 된 것이다.)

In response, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, running in the by-election for North Busan constituency, said, "The Daejang-dong tycoons have all been released. This is the worst kind of low-quality politics," and added, "I will smash the Lee Jae-myung regime's worst low-quality politics in Busan's North District. Only Han Dong-hoon can do it." (이에 대해 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 무소속 한동훈 후보도 “대장동 재벌들이 모두 석방됐다. 최악의 저질 정치”라며 “부산 북구에서 이재명 정권의 최악의 저질 정치를 박살 내겠다. 한동훈만이 할 수 있다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, the PPP is launching a signature campaign starting today to block disciplinary action against prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who investigated the Ssangbangwool North Korean remittance case. The PPP's special committee to block the special prosecution law for cancelling indictments stated, "The indefinite suspension and attempted discipline of prosecutor Park Sang-yong is not a simple personnel measure," and added, "It is the worst of evils aimed at shaking trials related to President Lee Jae-myung and ultimately leading to the cancellation of judgments," as it announced the campaign. (한편 국민의힘은 이날부터 쌍방울 대북 송금 사건을 수사한 박상용 검사에 대한 징계 시도를 저지하기 위한 서명운동을 시작한다. 국민의힘 공소취소 특검법저지 특별위원회는 이날 “박상용 검사에 대한 무한 직무정지와 징계 시도는 단순한 인사 조치가 아니다”라며 “이재명 대통령 관련 재판을 흔들고, 결국 재판취소를 만들 악 중의 악”이라며 서명 운동을 진행한다고 밝혔다.)

Earlier, the Ministry of Justice extended Park's suspension indefinitely. At the end of last month, the ministry sent an 'order to suspend duties' to the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, stating that Park's duties would be suspended from June 6, 2026, until further notice. Park had been suspended from his duties since April 6 for two months. The deadline was initially set for the 5th of this month, right after the June 3 local elections, but the ministry extended Park's suspension period. (앞서 법무부는 박 검사의 직무 정지 기간을 무기한 연장했다. 법무부는 지난달 말 대검찰청 등에 박 검사 직무를 2026년 6월 6일부터 별도 발령 시까지 정지한다는 ‘직무집행정지명령’ 공문을 보냈다. 박 검사는 지난 4월 6일부터 직무가 2개월 간 정지됐다. 기한은 6·3 지방선거 직후인 이달 5일까지였으나 법무부가 박 검사의 직무 정지 기간을 연장한 것이다.)

item.title: ACI: "In First Year of Lee administration, 70 Collective Complaints and Over 18,000 Corruption Reports Processed" (권익위 “李정부 출범 1년간 집단 민원 70건, 부패 신고 1만8000여건 처리”)
item.description:
ACI: "In First Year of Lee administration, 70 Collective Complaints and Over 18,000 Corruption Reports Processed" (권익위 “李정부 출범 1년간 집단 민원 70건, 부패 신고 1만8000여건 처리”)

Ahead of the first anniversary of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC) has highlighted the resolution of 70 collective complaints, the integration of government agency representative phone numbers, and the expanded handling of corruption and public interest reports as key achievements. (국민권익위원회가 이재명 정부 출범 1주년을 앞두고 집단 민원 70건 해결, 정부 기관 대표 전화번호 통합, 부패·공익 신고 사건 처리 확대 등을 핵심 성과로 제시했다.)

ACRC Chairperson Jeong Il-yeon met with reporters at the Government Complex Seoul on the 1st and stated, "Over the past year, the ACRC has mediated and resolved 70 collective complaints, alleviating the difficulties of approximately 30,000 citizens, and reduced repetitive complaints by about 150,000 cases." (권익위 정일연 위원장은 1일 정부서울청사에서 기자들과 만나 “권익위는 지난 1년간 집단 민원 70건을 조정·해결해 국민 약 3만명의 어려움을 해결했고, 반복 민원 약 15만건을 줄였다”고 했다.)

Regarding these achievements, Chairperson Jeong said, "The primary cause is our government's will to resolve complaints," and explained, "In January, we established a new bureau called the 'Collective Conflict Mediation Bureau' and have deployed a substantial number of personnel to handle collective and repetitive complaints." He added, "To establish a government-wide response base for collective conflicts, we plan to soon announce a 'Roadmap for Resolving Collective Conflict Complaints and Special Complaints of the People's Sovereignty Government' in cooperation with relevant agencies." (이 같은 성과에 대해 정 위원장은 “우리 정부의 민원 해결 의지가 주된 원인”이라며 “지난 1월 집단갈등조정국이라는 국 하나를 신설해 수많은 인원을 집단·반복 민원 해결에 투입하고 있다”고 설명했다. 그는 “집단 갈등에 대한 범정부 대응 기반을 마련하고자 관계 기관 합동으로 ‘국민주권정부 집단 갈등 민원, 특이 민원 해결 로드맵’도 곧 발표할 계획”이라고 했다.)

Chairperson Jeong also stated, "In July last year, together with the Presidential Committee on National Planning, we operated the 'Everyone's Square on Wheels' bus service, receiving a total of 850 citizen proposals and complaints from 13 local governments. Through this process, we resolved citizen grievances, such as traffic inconveniences caused by railway construction, through consultations between relevant agencies." (정 위원장은 “지난해 7월 국정기획위원회와 함께 ‘버스로 찾아가는 모두의 광장’을 운영해 13개 지방정부에서 총 850건의 국민 제안과 민원을 접수했고, 이 과정에서 철도 건설로 인해 발생한 통행 불편과 같은 국민 고충을 관계 기관 간 협의를 통해 해결했다”고도 했다.)

To efficiently handle the increasing number of complaints, Chairperson Jeong introduced an 'AI-based e-People Service' to four agencies, which provides recommended responses for complaint handlers when drafting replies. He noted plans to expand this service to all central administrative agencies by next year and to local governments and public institutions by 2030. (늘어나는 민원을 효율적으로 처리하기 위해, 정 위원장은 각 기관의 민원 처리 담당자들이 답변서를 작성할 때 추천 답변을 제공하는 ‘AI 기반 국민신문고 서비스’도 4개 기관에 도입했고, 이를 내년까지 전체 중앙행정기관, 2030년까지 지방정부와 공공기관으로 확대하기로 했다고 소개했다.)

Chairperson Jeong further stated, "To address citizen inconvenience caused by approximately 700 consultation hotlines operated by public institutions, we integrated the representative numbers of 15 central administrative agencies into the ACRC's 'National Call 110' in May. We plan to unify the representative numbers of 34 central administrative agencies by 2027." He added, "The number of public institution consultation hotlines citizens can reach by calling 110 will be expanded from the current 150 to 300 within this year." (정 위원장은 또 “공공기관이 운영하는 상담 번호가 약 700개에 달해 발생하는 국민 불편을 해소하고자 지난 5월 15개 중앙행정기관의 대표 번호를 권익위의 ‘국민콜 110’으로 통합했다”며 “2027년까지 34개 중앙행정기관의 대표 번호를 통합할 예정”이라고 했다. “국민이 110에 전화해 연결될 수 있는 공공기관 상담 번호는 현행 150개에서 연내 300개로 확대하겠다”고 했다.)

Chairperson Jeong also said, "We have prepared improvement plans for systems closely related to citizens' daily lives and recommended them to relevant agencies." For example, the ACRC has required local governments to add a ground subsidence-related item to their public facility liability insurance to strengthen compensation for sinkhole accident victims. It also ensured that vehicles that mistakenly exit a highway and immediately re-enter are not charged the basic toll twice. In administrative trials, economically vulnerable groups can now have a public defender appointed from the time of filing. (정 위원장은 “국민 일상과 밀접한 제도에 대해 개선안을 마련해 관계 기관에 권고했다”고도 했다. 예를 들어, 권익위는 지방자치단체가 가입하는 영조물 배상보험에 지반 침하 관련 항목을 신설해 싱크홀 사고 피해자에 대한 배상을 강화하도록 하고, 고속도로를 잘못 나갔다가 곧바로 재진입하는 자동차에는 통행료 기본요금을 이중으로 받지 않도록 했다. 행정심판은 경제적 취약계층의 경우 청구할 때부터 국선 대리인이 선임될 수 있게 했다.)

Chairperson Jeong also introduced, "We have actively handled reports of corrupt acts and public interest violations and strengthened the protection and rewards for whistleblowers." He stated, "Over the past year, the number of reported case handlings was 18,645, a 55.7% increase compared to the same period last year, and protection case handlings reached 1,195, a 154.3% increase." He added, "In December, a citizen who reported an illegal attempt to gratuitously transfer national and public land to a redevelopment union during an urban redevelopment project received a record compensation of 2 billion won." (정 위원장은 또 “부패 행위, 공익 침해 행위 신고를 적극 처리하고 신고자 보호·포상도 강화했다”고 소개했다. 그는 “지난 1년간 신고 사건 처리 건수는 1만8645건으로 전년 동기 대비 55.7% 상승했고, 보호 사건 처리는 1195건으로 154.3% 높아졌다”고 했다. “지난 12월 도시 재개발 사업 시행 중 국공유지를 재개발 조합에 위법하게 무상 양도하려던 사건을 신고한 국민에게는 역대 최고인 20억원의 보상금을 지급했다”고도 했다.)

Chairperson Jeong also introduced, "To establish a fair hiring culture, we created basic regulations for fair hiring of workers under central administrative agencies in April." Accordingly, procedures and principles for hiring non-civil servants, such as public service workers, fixed-term employees, and part-time workers, by each agency will be standardized. (정 위원장은 “공정 채용 문화 정착을 위해, 지난 4월 중앙행정기관 소속 근로자의 공정 채용을 위한 기본 규정을 신설했다”고도 소개했다. 이에 따라 각 기관이 공무직, 기간제, 단시간 근로자 등 비공무원을 채용할 때의 절차와 원칙이 표준화된다.)

Chairperson Jeong stated, "Beyond the key achievements I've mentioned today, we will do our utmost to create changes that citizens can feel. The ACRC will listen more closely to the voices of the people to protect their rights and realize a clean society, taking the lead in building a nation where the people are the true owners." (정 위원장은 “오늘 말씀드린 핵심 성과 이외에도 국민이 체감할 수 있는 변화를 만들 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”며 “권익위는 국민 권익을 보호하고 청렴한 사회를 구현하기 위해 국민 목소리에 더욱 귀를 기울이고 국민이 주인인 나라를 만드는 데 앞장서겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Urges Candidates to Refrain from Campaign Songs and Dance Moves Following Hanwha Aerospace Accident (장동혁, 한화 에어로 사고에 “후보들 로고송, 율동 자제하라”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk Urges Candidates to Refrain from Campaign Songs and Dance Moves Following Hanwha Aerospace Accident (장동혁, 한화 에어로 사고에 “후보들 로고송, 율동 자제하라”)

People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk issued an emergency directive on the 1st, in the wake of the Hanwha Aerospace accident in Daejeon, stating, "I instruct all PPP candidates and election campaign teams nationwide to refrain from using campaign songs and choreographed moves, and to conduct election campaigns in a subdued manner." Leader Jang, along with floor leader Song Eon-seok and others, canceled all official schedules. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 1일 대전 한화에어로스페이스 사고가 발생하자 “전국의 국민의힘 후보와 선거 캠프에 로고송 사용과 율동을 자제하고 차분한 선거 운동을 진행하라”고 긴급 지시했다. 장 대표를 비롯해 송언석 원내대표 등은 공식 일정을 전부 취소했다.)

On Facebook that day, Leader Jang said, "I pray for the repose of those who tragically lost their lives in the Hanwha Aerospace explosion accident in Daejeon, and offer my heartfelt condolences to the bereaved families. I also wish a speedy recovery to those who were injured." He added, "I urge the government to do its utmost to swiftly manage the accident and restore damages. The PPP will also spare no effort in providing necessary support." (장 대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “대전 한화에어로스페이스 폭발 사고로 안타깝게 돌아가신 분들의 명복을 빌며, 유가족분들께 진심으로 위로의 말씀을 드린다”며 “아울러, 부상을 당하신 분들의 조속한 치유를 기원한다”고 했다. 그는 “정부는 조속한 사고 수습과 피해 복구에 최선을 다해주기 바란다”며 “국민의힘도 필요한 지원을 아끼지 않겠다”고 했다.)

Floor leader Song Eon-seok wrote on Facebook that day, "I ask candidates and election committees in the Daejeon area to do their utmost in assessing the situation on the ground. Furthermore, I strongly urge all local election candidates and election committees nationwide to focus their attention and concern on minimizing casualties from the Daejeon accident, and to be extremely cautious of any words or actions that contravene public common sense." (송언석 원내대표는 이날 페이스북에서 “대전 지역의 후보자들과 선대위는 현장 상황 파악에 만전을 기해주실 것을 당부드린다“며 ”아울러 전국의 모든 지방선거 후보자들과 각급 선대위는 대전 사고의 인명 피해가 최소화할 수 있도록 함께 관심과 걱정을 모아주시고, 국민의 상식에 어긋나는 언행에 극도로 유의할 것을 강력히 당부드린다”고 했다.)

PPP Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon said in a statement, "I pray for the repose of those who passed away in this unfortunate accident, and offer my deepest condolences to the bereaved families who are in profound grief from this sudden tragic news. I also sincerely wish for the swift recovery of those who have been injured, including from burns, and are receiving treatment." (국민의힘 박성훈 수석대변인은 논평에서 “불의의 사고로 유명을 달리하신 고인들의 명복을 빌며, 갑작스러운 비보로 깊은 슬픔에 잠겨 계실 유가족분들께 가슴 깊은 위로의 말씀을 전한다. 또 화상 등 부상을 입고 치료를 받고 계신 분들의 빠른 쾌유를 진심으로 기원한다”고 했다.)

He added, "The PPP will closely monitor the process of managing this accident, and will do its utmost at the parliamentary level to prepare all support and measures to ensure that support for the bereaved families and treatment for the injured are carried out without any negligence. I once again pray for the repose of the victims, and extend my deep condolences and sympathy to the bereaved families." (그러면서 “국민의힘은 이번 사고의 수습 과정을 면밀히 살피고, 유가족 지원과 부상자 치료가 한 치의 소홀함 없이 이루어질 수 있도록 국회 차원의 모든 지원과 대책 마련에 최선을 다하겠다”며 “다시 한 번 희생자들의 명복을 빌며, 유가족 여러분께 깊은 애도와 위로의 말씀을 드린다”고 했다.)

PPP Daejeon mayoral candidate Lee Jang-woo also wrote on Facebook that day, "I express my deep condolences to those who lost precious lives in the Hanwha Aerospace accident today. My heart is heavy as I offer my sympathy to the bereaved families and the injured," adding, "I will fulfill all my roles to manage the accident and ensure a thorough investigation." (국민의힘 이장우 대전시장 후보도 이날 페이스북에서 “오늘 발생한 한화에어로스페이스 사고로 소중한 생명을 잃으신 분들께 깊은 애도의 뜻을 표한다. 유가족과 부상자분들께도 참담한 마음으로 위로의 말씀을 드린다“며 ”저는 사고 수습과 철저한 조사 등을 위해 모든 역할을 다하겠다”고 했다.)

Candidate Lee stated, "I will closely cooperate with relevant agencies to focus all administrative efforts on managing the accident and supporting the victims. Furthermore, I will thoroughly investigate the cause of the accident and swiftly prepare necessary measures, including a comprehensive review of the safety management system." He concluded, "Once again, I pray for the repose of the victims, and extend my deep condolences to the bereaved families." <<>> (이 후보는 “관계 기관과 긴밀히 협력해 사고 수습과 피해자 지원에 모든 행정력을 집중하겠다”며 “아울러 사고 원인을 철저히 조사하고, 안전관리 체계를 전면적으로 점검하는 등 필요한 대책을 신속히 마련하겠다”고 했다. 그는 “다시 한 번 희생자들의 명복을 빌며, 유가족 여러분께 깊은 애도의 마음을 전한다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Orders "Mobilize All Available Resources" for Hanwha Aerospace Explosion (李대통령, 한화에어로 폭발사고에 “인명 구조에 가용자원 총동원”)
item.description:
President Lee Orders "Mobilize All Available Resources" for Hanwha Aerospace Explosion (李대통령, 한화에어로 폭발사고에 “인명 구조에 가용자원 총동원”)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 1st instructed authorities to "mobilize all available resources for rescue and accident recovery" in response to an explosion at a Hanwha Aerospace facility in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. (이재명 대통령은 1일 대전시 유성구의 한화에어로스페이스 사업장에서 발생한 폭발 사고에 대해 “인명 구조와 사고 수습에 가용한 자원을 총동원해 대처하라”고 지시했다.)

Senior Presidential Secretary for Public Relations Kang Yoo-jung announced this directive via a notice on the same day, stating that President Lee issued the order after being briefed on the explosion. Kang added, "The President also instructed a thorough investigation into the cause of the accident and the development of measures to prevent recurrence." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 공지를 통해 이 대통령이 폭발 사고를 보고받은 뒤 이같이 지시했다고 밝혔다. 강 수석대변인은 “이 대통령이 사고 원인을 철저히 조사하고 추후 재발 방지 대책도 마련할 것을 지시했다”고 전했다.)

Earlier, at around 10:59 a.m. on the same day, an explosion accompanied by a loud bang and fire occurred at the Hanwha Aerospace facility in Oesam-dong, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. The accident has so far resulted in five fatalities and two injuries, with the injured transported to hospitals. (앞서 이날 오전 10시 59분쯤 대전시 유성구 외삼동의 한화에어로스페이스 사업장에서 폭발음과 함께 화재가 발생했다. 이 사고로 현재까지 5명이 숨지고 2명이 부상을 입어 병원으로 이송된 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: Personnel Ministry: "Over First Year of Government, Improved Treatment for Junior and Field Officials, Strengthened Legal Protection" (인사처 “정부 출범 1년간 저연차·현장 공무원 처우 개선, 소송 보호 강화”)
item.description:
Personnel Ministry: "Over First Year of Government, Improved Treatment for Junior and Field Officials, Strengthened Legal Protection" (인사처 “정부 출범 1년간 저연차·현장 공무원 처우 개선, 소송 보호 강화”)

The Ministry of Personnel Management has highlighted the strengthening of the proactive administration protection system, reform of the civil servant duty system, improved treatment for junior and field officials, and expansion of early promotion systems as key achievements during the first year of the Lee Jae-myung administration. (인사혁신처가 적극 행정 보호 체계 강화, 공무원 당직 제도 개편, 저연차·현장 공무원 처우 개선, 조기 승진제 확대 등을 이재명 정부 출범 1년간의 핵심 성과로 제시했다.)

On the 1st, the Ministry distributed a press release, stating, "During the first year of the People's Sovereignty Government, the Ministry focused on strengthening the institutional foundation for civil servants to work with peace of mind, establishing a personnel system that allows growth based on performance and expertise, and improving the treatment of junior and field officials." (인사처는 1일 보도 자료를 배포해 “국민주권정부 출범 1년 동안 인사처는 공무원이 안심하고 일할 수 있는 제도적 기반을 강화하는 한편, 성과와 전문성에 따라 성장할 수 있는 인사 체계를 마련하고, 저연차·현장 공무원의 처우를 개선하는 데 중점을 뒀다”고 자평했다.)

According to the Ministry, the system has been revised so that when civil servants handle tasks in accordance with the opinions of the Active Administration Committee, they are exempt from audit liability, including audits by both the agency itself and the Board of Audit and Inspection. Additionally, civil servants who face investigations or lawsuits despite engaging in proactive administration can receive up to 30 million won in legal support, and coverage through liability insurance is available without limit on the number of claims. (인사처에 따르면, 공무원이 적극행정위원회의 의견에 따라 업무를 처리한 경우, 기관 자체 감사는 물론 감사원 감사에도 면책을 받도록 제도가 개편됐다. 또 적극 행정을 했는데도 수사나 소송을 당한 공무원은 3000만원까지 소송 지원을 받고, 책임보험을 통한 보장도 횟수 제한 없이 받을 수 있게 됐다.)

The Ministry noted that last year, for the first time in 76 years since the system was introduced in 1949, the national civil servant duty system was completely overhauled. Remote on-call duty has been significantly expanded, and agencies operating 24-hour situation rooms can now allow situation room duty to serve as on-call duty. (인사처는 지난해에는 1949년 제도 도입 이후 76년 만에 처음으로 국가공무원 당직 제도를 전면 개편했다. 재택 당직을 대폭 확대하고, 24시간 상황실을 운영하는 기관은 상황실 근무가 당직을 겸할 수 있게 했다.)

To strengthen civil servants' right to rest, Labor Day on May 1st and Constitution Day on July 17th have been designated as public holidays, and if these days fall on weekends or other holidays, substitute holidays are applied. The age limit for children eligible for parental leave has also been expanded from under 8 years old (2nd grade of elementary school) to under 12 years old (6th grade of elementary school), and a new leave for infertility treatment has been introduced. (또 공무원의 휴식권을 강화하기 위해 5월 1일 노동절과 7월 17일 제헌절을 공휴일로 지정했고, 이 날들이 주말이나 다른 공휴일과 겹치는 경우에는 대체 공휴일이 적용되도록 했다. 또 공무원이 육아 휴직을 쓸 수 있는 자녀 연령대를 8세(초등학교 2학년) 이하에서 12세(초등학교 6학년) 이하로 넓혔고, 난임 휴직을 신설했다.)

Civil servant salaries have been increased by 3.5%, the highest in nine years, and the starting salaries for junior working-level civil servants in grades 7 to 9 have been additionally raised by 3.1 percentage points. The Ministry predicts that by next year, the monthly salary of a starting Grade 9 civil servant will reach around 3 million won. (공무원 보수는 9년 만에 최고인 3.5% 올렸고, 7~9급 저연차 실무 공무원의 초임 봉급은 3.1%포인트 추가 인상됐다. 인사처는 내년에 초임 9급 공무원의 보수가 월 300만원 수준에 달할 것이라고 내다봤다.)

For civil servants in disaster and safety roles, compensation such as allowances has been expanded, and those who significantly reduce disaster damage or achieve major accident prevention can receive special promotions even if no vacancies exist in higher positions. The minimum service period required for promotion based on tenure has also been shortened. Compensation for police and fire officials has also been expanded. (재난·안전 담당 공무원에 대해서는 수당 등 보상을 확대하고, 재난 피해를 줄이거나 사고 예방에 큰 성과를 낸 공무원은 상위 직급에 결원이 없더라도 특별 승진이 될 수 있게 했다. 근속 승진에 필요한 최소 재직 연수도 단축됐다. 경찰·소방공무원에 대한 보상도 확대됐다.)

A 'Grade 5 early promotion system' has been introduced, allowing Grade 6 civil servants with outstanding work performance to be quickly promoted to Grade 5. In fields requiring specialized expertise such as artificial intelligence (AI), international trade, and labor inspection, systems are being pursued to allow civil servants to work long-term and develop their expertise. The expansion of open competitive positions at the director and manager levels to attract top talent from the private sector is also being pursued. In some fields like AI, salary caps have been lifted to recruit private-sector experts. (업무 성과가 뛰어난 6급 공무원은 5급으로 빠르게 승진할 수 있는 ‘5급 조기 승진제’도 도입했다. 인공지능(AI), 국제 통상, 노동 감독 등 전문성이 필요한 분야에는 공무원이 오래 근무하면서 전문성을 키울 수 있게 하는 제도도 추진된다. 민간에서 우수 인재를 끌어오기 위한 국·과장급 개방형 직위 확대도 추진된다. AI 등 일부 분야에서는 민간 전문가 영입을 위해 연봉 상한도 폐지했다.)

Minister of Personnel Management Choi Dong-seok stated, "For the public service to gain the trust of the people, it is important to create conditions where civil servants can actively work for the people," adding, "We will do our utmost to realize a public service that creates changes the people can feel." (최동석 인사처장은 “공직 사회가 국민 신뢰를 받기 위해서는 국민을 위해 공무원이 적극적으로 일할 수 있는 여건을 만드는 것이 중요하다”며 “국민이 체감하는 변화를 만들어내는 공직 사회 구현을 위해 최선을 다하겠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Swift Rescue and Firefighting Top Priority" in Daejeon Explosion (오세훈, 대전 폭발 사고에 “빠른 구조·화재 진압 최우선”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon: "Swift Rescue and Firefighting Top Priority" in Daejeon Explosion (오세훈, 대전 폭발 사고에 “빠른 구조·화재 진압 최우선”)

Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul Mayor, stated on the 1st regarding the explosion at the Hanwha Aerospace facility in Daejeon, "Swift rescue operations and firefighting are the top priority." (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장 후보는 1일 대전 한화에어로스페이스 폭발 사고와 관련해 “빠른 구조와 화재 진압이 최우선”이라고 밝혔다.)

Oh's election campaign committee announced through a media notice, "Candidate Oh emphasized that swift rescue and firefighting are the top priority in relation to the accident, and today's campaign events will prohibit all dance routines and campaign songs, proceeding with a calm and quiet schedule." It also stated, "Candidate Oh urged relevant agencies to do their utmost in rapid rescue operations and managing the accident scene." (오세훈 후보 선거대책위원회는 이날 언론 공지를 통해 “오 후보는 사고와 관련해 빠른 구조와 화재 진압이 최우선임을 강조하며, 금일 유세는 율동과 로고송을 전면 금지하고 차분하고 조용한 일정으로 진행한다는 방침”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “오 후보는 관계기관이 신속한 인명 구조와 사고 현장 수습에 최선을 다해줄 것을 당부했다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party's Seoul chapter said in the same notice, "Please stop campaign song and dance routines on campaign vehicles while rescue operations and accident management are ongoing," adding, "Focus on quiet campaigning, phone calls, and text messages." (국민의힘 서울시당은 이날 공지에서 “사고 수습과 인명 구조가 진행되는 동안 유세차의 로고송과 율동을 멈춰주시기 바란다”며 “차분한 유세, 전화 문자 선거 운동에 집중해달라”고 했다.)

Earlier, the People Power Party leadership issued an urgent directive to all candidates nationwide, "Refrain from using campaign songs and dance routines, and conduct calm election campaigns." Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said on Facebook, "I offer my deepest condolences to those who tragically lost their lives in the Hanwha Aerospace explosion in Daejeon, and extend sincere sympathies to the bereaved families. I pray for the swift recovery of the injured." (앞서 국민의힘 지도부도 전국 후보들에게 “로고송 사용과 율동을 자제하고 차분한 선거 운동을 진행하라”는 긴급 지시를 내렸다. 장동혁 대표는 페이스북에서 “대전 한화에어로스페이스 폭발 사고로 안타깝게 돌아가신 분들의 명복을 빌며, 유가족분들께 진심으로 위로의 말씀을 드린다”며 “부상을 당하신 분들의 조속한 치유를 기원한다”고 했다.)

Jang further stated, "I hope the government will do its utmost for a swift accident response and damage recovery," and "The People Power Party will spare no effort in providing necessary support." Jang and floor leader Song Eon-seok completely canceled their campaign schedules for the day. (이어 장 대표는 “정부는 조속한 사고 수습과 피해 복구에 최선을 다해주기 바란다”며 “국민의힘도 필요한 지원을 아끼지 않겠다”고 했다. 장 대표와 송언석 원내대표 등은 이날 유세 일정을 전면 취소했다.)

At 10:59 AM on the 1st, a 119 report was received about an explosion at the Hanwha Aerospace factory in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, prompting firefighting and rescue operations by authorities. (이날 오전 10시 59분 대전 유성구 한화에어로스페이스 대전공장에서 폭발 사고가 발생했다는 119 신고가 접수돼 소방 당국이 진화 및 구조 작업을 벌이고 있다.)

item.title: MB: "Seoul Forest was created by an opposition Seoul Mayor... We need to elect a competent candidate" (MB “서울숲은 野 서울시장이 만든 것…일 잘하는 후보 뽑아야”)
item.description:
MB: "Seoul Forest was created by an opposition Seoul Mayor... We need to elect a competent candidate" (MB “서울숲은 野 서울시장이 만든 것…일 잘하는 후보 뽑아야”)

Former President Lee Myung-bak visited Seoul Forest in Seongdong-gu, Seoul on the 1st and stated, "We must elect a competent mayor and district office head." Opened in 2005, Seoul Forest is considered one of the key achievements during former President Lee Myung-bak's tenure as Seoul Mayor. (이명박 전 대통령이 1일 서울 성동구 서울숲을 방문해 “일 잘하는 시장·구청장을 뽑아야 한다”고 했다. 2005년 개장한 서울숲은 이명박 전 대통령의 서울시장 재임 시기 대표 업적 중 하나로 꼽힌다.)

Meeting with reporters at Seoul Forest that morning, the former president said, "When I was making Seoul Forest (during my term as Seoul Mayor), there were so many people opposing it." He added, "In the end, once it was completed, it became a great park that all Seoul citizens can conveniently access." Attendees at the event included former President Lee's family, Ko Jae-hyun, the People Power Party candidate for Seongdong-gu District Office head, Representative Choi Su-jin, who serves as chair of the People Power Party's district committee for Jung-gu and Seongdong-gu, and former Representative Yoon Hee-sook, who is a co-chair of the election committee for Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul Mayor. (이 전 대통령은 이날 오전 서울숲에서 기자들과 만나 “(서울시장 시절) 서울숲 만들 때 반대하는 사람 참 많았다”며 “결국 이루고 나니 모든 서울 시민이 아주 편리하게 오갈 수 있는 좋은 공원이 됐다”고 했다. 이 자리에는 이 전 대통령 가족을 포함해, 고재현 국민의힘 성동구청장 후보, 국민의힘 중·성동구을 당협위원장인 최수진 의원, 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보 선거대책위원회 공동선대위원장을 맡고 있는 윤희숙 전 의원 등이 참석했다.)

Citing Cheonggyecheon and T-money as examples, the former president remarked, "When I was Seoul Mayor, I was an opposition party mayor, but I worked hard even in difficult circumstances and achieved all of this." He noted, "There was so much opposition when I was doing that," adding, "It got to the point where politicians and others flocked to demand that the mayor step down." (이 전 대통령은 청계천과 티머니 등을 거론하며 “서울시장 할 때 야당 시장이었는데 어려운 환경 속에서도 열심히 일만 해서 이를 다 이뤘다”고 했다. 그는 “그걸 할 때 반대가 너무 많았다”며 “정치인 등이 몰려와서 시장 물러가라고 했을 정도”라고 했다.)

He said, "Local government elections (are coming soon)," and added, "Rather than campaigning, I hope people will elect a mayor who does a good job and a district office head who does a good job." (그는 “(이제 곧) 지방자치단체 선거가 있다”며 “선거운동을 한다기보다는 일 잘하는 시장, 일 잘하는 구청장을 뽑아 주면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

At the scene that day, citizens and supporters gathered, chanting the former president's name. He responded by shaking hands with the citizens and taking commemorative photos with them. (이날 현장에는 시민과 지지자가 몰려 이 전 대통령 이름을 연호했다. 이 전 대통령은 시민들과 악수를 나누며 화답했고 시민들과 함께 기념사진 촬영을 했다.)

Former President Lee's schedule that day was interpreted as a show of support for Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon from the sidelines. Earlier, candidate Oh had countered Democratic Party Seoul Mayor candidate Jung Won-oh, a former Seongdong-gu District Office head, who touted the development of Seongsu-dong as one of his greatest achievements, stating, "The development of Seoul Forest was pushed forward during former Mayor Lee Myung-bak's time, and designating Seongsu-dong as a special development promotion zone to allow knowledge industry centers and create youth jobs was something I did when I was Seoul Mayor." (이 전 대통령의 이날 일정은 오세훈 서울시장을 측면에서 지원한 것으로 해석됐다. 앞서 오 후보는 성동구청장을 지낸 더불어민주당 정원오 서울시장 후보가 성수동 개발을 최대 업적 중 하나로 꼽는 데 대해 “서울숲 개발은 이명박 전 시장 때 추진됐고, 성수동을 특정개발진흥지구로 지정해 지식산업센터가 들어오며 청년 일자리가 만들어진 것도 제가 서울시장일 때 한 일”이라며 견제했었다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim instructs "priority on rescue" after Hanwha Aerospace explosion (金총리, 한화에어로스페이스 폭발 사고에 “인명 구조에 최선”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim instructs "priority on rescue" after Hanwha Aerospace explosion (金총리, 한화에어로스페이스 폭발 사고에 “인명 구조에 최선”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok on the 1st, regarding the explosion accident at Hanwha Aerospace’s Daejeon plant, ordered that "all efforts be focused on rescuing lives." (김민석 국무총리가 1일 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 일어난 폭발 사고와 관련해 “인명 구조에 최선을 다하라”고 지시했다.)

According to the Prime Minister's Office, in relation to the accident that occurred that morning, Prime Minister Kim instructed that "the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the National Fire Agency, the National Police Agency, and Daejeon City mobilize all available equipment and personnel to make utmost efforts in fire suppression and life rescue to prevent additional damage." (총리실에 따르면, 김 총리는 이날 오전 일어난 사고와 관련해 “행정안전부, 소방청, 경찰청, 대전시는 가용한 모든 장비와 인력을 동원해 화재 진압과 인명 구조에 최선을 다해 추가 피해가 발생치 않도록 하라”고 지시했다.)

He also said, "Relevant agencies including Daejeon City, the Ministry of Employment and Labor, the Ministry of Science and ICT, the Korea AeroSpace Administration, and the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment should support necessary personnel and equipment for emergency response and actively cooperate to ensure smooth on-site rescue operations." (“대전시, 고용노동부, 과학기술정보통신부, 우주항공청, 기후에너지환경부 등 관계 기관은 상황 대응에 필요한 인력과 장비를 지원하고, 현장 구조 활동이 원활히 이뤄질 수 있도록 적극 협조하라”고도 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim further stated, "Identify available medical facilities in the nearby area and minimize casualties by promptly transporting any confirmed injured persons." He also emphasized, "The National Fire Agency must ensure the safety of firefighters, including those currently engaged in firefighting at the scene." (김 총리는 이어 “인근 지역에 수용 가능한 의료 시설을 파악하고, 부상자 확인 시 신속한 이송으로 인명 피해를 최소화하라”고 했다. “소방청은 현장 활동 중인 화재진압대원 등 소방공무원의 안전에도 만전을 기하라”고도 당부했다.)

Around 10:59 a.m. that day, an explosion occurred at Hanwha Aerospace’s Daejeon plant in Oesam-dong, Yuseong-gu, Daejeon. To date, it is reported that four people have died and two have suffered burns. The police and fire authorities suspect the explosion happened during a propulsion test and plan to investigate the cause of the accident once the fire is extinguished. (이날 오전 10시 59분쯤 대전 유성구 외삼동 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 폭발 사고가 일어났다. 현재까지 4명이 숨지고 2명이 화상을 입은 것으로 알려졌다. 경찰과 소방 당국은 추진체 시험 중 폭발 사고가 일어난 것으로 추정하고 화재를 진압하는 대로 사고 원인을 조사할 예정이다.)

item.title: Kwanhun Club Presents Plaque of Appreciation to U.S. Embassy in Seoul … "Gratitude for Contributions to Korean Media and Democracy" (관훈클럽, 주한 미국대사관에 감사패 수여 …“韓 언론·민주주의 기여에 감사”)
item.description:
Kwanhun Club Presents Plaque of Appreciation to U.S. Embassy in Seoul … "Gratitude for Contributions to Korean Media and Democracy" ( 관훈클럽, 주한 미국대사관에 감사패 수여 …“韓 언론·민주주의 기여에 감사”)

The Kwanhun Club presented a plaque of appreciation to the U.S. Embassy in Seoul on the 1st for its efforts in advancing Korean media and strengthening South Korea-U.S. relations. (관훈클럽이 1일 한국 언론 발전과 한미 관계 증진을 위해 애써온 주한미국대사관에 감사패를 수여했다.)

The Kwanhun Club announced that it held a ceremony titled "Commemorating the 250th Anniversary of the Founding of the United States – Plaque of Appreciation to the U.S. Embassy in Seoul" at the Korea Press Center in Jung-gu, Seoul, on the same day. The Kwanhun Club is a press organization founded in 1957, centered around journalists who had undergone training across the United States with support from the U.S. Embassy in Seoul and affiliated U.S. government agencies after the Korean War. (관훈클럽은 이날 서울 중구 한국프레스센터에서 ‘미국 건국 250주년 기념 주한미국대사관 감사패 수여식’을 개최했다고 밝혔다. 관훈클럽은 6·25 전쟁 이후 주한미국대사관과 미국 정부 관련 기관의 지원을 받아 미국 각지로 연수를 다녀온 언론인을 중심으로 1957년 창립된 언론 단체다.)

The presentation of the plaque is also known to carry the significance of celebrating the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States. Since the establishment of the Kwanhun Club, the U.S. Embassy in Seoul has supported various publications, international exchange projects, and journalist training programs published by the club, contributing to the development of South Korea's media landscape and the enhancement of mutual understanding between South Korea and the United States. (이번 감사패 수여는 미국 건국 250주년을 축하하는 의미도 담긴 것으로 알려졌다. 주한미국대사관은 관훈클럽 창립 후 관훈클럽에서 발간하는 각종 간행물과 국제교류 사업, 언론인 교육 프로그램 등을 지원하며 대한민국 언론계의 발전과 한미 양국 간 상호 이해 증진에 기여해 왔다.)

Approximately 30 people from various sectors attended the event, including James Heller, Chargé d'Affaires of the U.S. Embassy in Seoul, and other embassy officials, National Assembly member Kim Geon, Jeong Yeon-doo, Director General for Foreign Policy and Strategy at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kim Jong-wook, Honorary Chairman of the KATUSA Association, and Shin Beom-cheol, former Vice Minister of National Defense. (이날 행사에는 제임스 헬러 주한미국대사관 대사대리를 비롯한 미국대사관 관계자들과 김건 국회의원, 정연두 외교부 외교전략정보본부장, 김종욱 카투사연합회 명예회장, 신범철 전 국방부 차관 등 각계 인사 약 30명이 참석했다.)

Lee Ha-won, the 73rd Secretary-General of the Kwanhun Club, stated, "The Kwanhun Club was founded in 1957, led by young journalists who had undergone training in the United States with assistance from the U.S. Embassy in Seoul," adding, "We express our gratitude to the U.S. Embassy in Seoul for its long-standing contributions to the development of Korean media and democracy." (이하원 제73대 관훈클럽 총무는 “관훈클럽은 1957년 주한 미국 대사관의 도움 등으로 미국 연수를 다녀온 젊은 기자들이 주축이 돼 창립됐다”며 “오랜 시간 동안 한국 언론과 민주주의 발전에 기여해 온 주한 미국 대사관에 감사의 뜻을 표한다”고 말했다.)

Chargé d'Affaires James Heller said, "As the United States marks its 250th founding anniversary this year, it is even more meaningful to commemorate this occasion with the Kwanhun Club," and added, "The members of the Kwanhun Club have consistently demonstrated expertise, integrity, and public spirit in their roles as journalists, and I deeply appreciate these efforts." (제임스 헬러 대사 대리는 “미국이 올해 건국 250주년을 맞이한 시점에서 관훈클럽과 이를 기념하게 돼 더욱 뜻깊게 생각한다”며 “관훈클럽 회원들은 전문성을 갖고 청렴하게 (언론인으로서) 공공정신을 몸소 실천해 왔는데, 이 같은 노고에 깊이 감사드린다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Government: "23,403 Drug Offenders Apprehended Last Year… Record High Seizure of Illicit Drugs Entering from Overseas" (정부 “지난해 마약사범 2만3403명 검거… 해외 유입 마약 적발 역대 최대”)
item.description:
Government: "23,403 Drug Offenders Apprehended Last Year… Record High Seizure of Illicit Drugs Entering from Overseas" (정부 “지난해 마약사범 2만3403명 검거… 해외 유입 마약 적발 역대 최대”)

The government announced that it has made a total effort to combat drug-related crimes, apprehending 23,403 drug offenders last year and forcibly repatriating fugitives who had fled abroad. (정부가 마약류 범죄에 총력 대응해 지난해 마약류 사범 2만3403명을 검거하고, 해외 도피 사범들을 강제 송환했다고 밝혔다.)

The Office for Government Policy Coordination, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, the National Police Agency, the Korea Coast Guard, the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, and the Korea Customs Service released these "Major Achievements in Drug Crime Response" on the 1st, ahead of the first anniversary of the Lee Jae-myung administration. (국무조정실과 법무부, 보건복지부, 대검찰청, 경찰청, 해양경찰청, 식품의약품안전처, 관세청은 이재명 정부 출범 1주년을 앞두고 1일 이 같은 내용의 ‘마약류 범죄 대응 주요 성과’를 발표했다.)

According to the government, in the 10 months from last June to this April following the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration, 5,386 online drug offenders were apprehended, and 3,233 kg of drugs brought in from overseas were seized, setting a record high for the same period. (정부에 따르면, 이재명 정부 출범 후 지난해 6월부터 올해 4월까지 10개월간 온라인 마약 사범 5386명을 검거하고 해외에서 반입되는 마약류 3233㎏을 적발해, 역대 같은 기간 최고치를 기록했다.)

The 'Special Task Force for Transnational Crime' established by the government successfully repatriated Park Wang-yeol, who was smuggling large quantities of drugs from the Philippines into South Korea, and the National Police Agency apprehended and repatriated Choi Byung-min, who supplied drugs to Park Wang-yeol. In addition, last November, a 'Joint Government Drug Crime Investigation Headquarters' was formed with specialized investigators from the prosecution, police, coast guard, and customs service. In the subsequent six months, 235 individuals from eight organized crime groups were booked, with 109 of them detained. (정부가 구성한 ‘초국가범죄 특별 대응 TF(태스크포스)’는 필리핀에서 한국으로 마약을 대규모로 유입시키던 박왕열을 국내 송환하는 데 성공했고, 경찰청은 박왕열에게 마약을 공급한 최병민을 검거·송환했다. 이 밖에도 지난해 11월 검찰·경찰·해경·관세청의 전문 수사 인력으로 ‘마약범죄 정부합동수사본부’를 구성해, 이후 6개월 사이에 조직 범죄 집단 8개 세력 등의 235명을 입건했고, 이 가운데 109명을 구속했다.)

The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety, in collaboration with the police and local governments, conducted crackdowns on medical institutions, uncovering 44 cases of misuse or abuse of ADHD medications and propofol, as well as fraudulent use of deceased individuals' or others' identities. They also apprehended six individuals who illegally distributed 160,000 ampoules of etomidate, a general anesthetic, and arrested doctors who overprescribed or abused drugs, as well as a doctor who falsified reports to cover up a death from illegal propofol use. The Korea Customs Service introduced a dual inspection system, where international mail that passes initial screening at airports and ports is re-examined with X-rays upon arrival at mail distribution centers, leading to the detection of illegal drugs. (식약처는 경찰, 지방자치단체와 함께 의료기관을 단속해 ADHD(주의력 결핍 행동장애) 치료제와 프로포폴 오·남용, 사망자·타인 명의 도용 등으로 44곳을 적발했다. 또 전신 마취제인 에토미데이트 앰플 16만개를 불법으로 유통시킨 6명을 검거하고, 마약류를 오남용 처방한 의사, 프로포폴 불법 사용으로 인한 사망을 숨기기 위해 허위 보고한 의사를 검거했다. 관세청은 공항·항만에서 1차 검사를 통과한 국제 우편물이 우편집중국에 도착하면 다시 한번 X선으로 검사하는 이중 검사 체계를 도입해 불법 마약류를 적발했다.)

The Ministry of Health and Welfare increased the budget for treatment cost support for drug addicts from 720 million won last year to 1.35 billion won this year, and expanded regional treatment and protection institutions from 9 to 11. It also decided to newly train 80 treatment and rehabilitation professionals this year. The Ministry of Justice developed a customized rehabilitation program called 'Recovery Connection Process' for correctional facilities and increased the number of dedicated rehabilitation correctional facilities from 4 to 6. (복지부는 마약류 중독자 치료를 늘리기 위해 치료비 지원 예산을 지난해 7억2000만원에서 올해 1억3500만원으로 늘렸고, 권역별 치료 보호 기관을 9곳에서 11곳으로 늘렸다. 치료·재활 전문 인력도 80명을 올해 신규로 양성하기로 했다. 법무부는 교정 시설 내 맞춤형 재활 프로그램인 ‘회복이음과정’을 개발하고, 재활 전담 교정 시설을 4곳에서 6곳으로 늘렸다.)

The government also stated that undercover investigations and covert operations to catch drug distribution organizations have been legalized, and the number of drugs that can be checked for patients' prescription history before medical institutions prescribe them has been increased from 3 to 5 types. (정부는 또 마약 유통 조직을 잡아내기 위한 신분 비공개 수사, 위장 수사가 법제화됐고, 의료기관에서 마약류를 처방하기 전 환자의 투약 이력을 확인할 수 있는 약품도 3종에서 5종으로 늘어났다고 밝혔다.)

Yoon Chang-ryeol, the head of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, said, "As there are still many tasks ahead, such as strengthening crackdowns on smuggling routes, improving systems to prevent illegal distribution, upgrading detection equipment, and enhancing treatment, rehabilitation, and prevention efforts, we will maintain a state of vigilance and continue robust, whole-of-government responses." (윤창렬 국무조정실장은 “밀반입 경로별 단속 강화, 불법 유통 방지 제도 개선, 탐지 장비 고도화, 치료·재활·예방 내실화 등 아직 과제가 산적해 있는 만큼, 긴장의 끈을 놓지 않고 강력한 범정부 대응을 지속해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim Visits Hanwha Aerospace Accident Site…“Conduct a Thorough Investigation into the Cause” (金총리, 한화에어로 사고 현장 방문… “원인 철저히 규명하라”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Visits Hanwha Aerospace Accident Site…“Conduct a Thorough Investigation into the Cause” (金총리, 한화에어로 사고 현장 방문… “원인 철저히 규명하라”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok on the 1st visited the Hanwha Aerospace plant in Yuseong-gu, Daejeon, where an explosion accident occurred, urging a thorough investigation into the cause of the accident and support for the bereaved families. (김민석 국무총리가 1일 폭발 사고가 일어난 대전 유성구 한화에어로스페이스 공장을 찾아 사고 원인에 대한 철저한 조사와 유가족 지원을 당부했다.)

After receiving a briefing on the damage situation at the accident site that afternoon, Prime Minister Kim, upon hearing that an on-site forensic examination was scheduled for the next day, asked, “Is it difficult to speculate on the cause at this point?” (김 총리는 이날 오후 사고 현장에서 피해 상황을 보고받은 뒤 내일 현장 감식이 예정돼 있다는 설명을 듣고 “현재까지는 (사고 원인을) 추정하기 어려운가”라고 물었다.)

Kim Ki-seon, head of the Yuseong Fire Station, replied, “Since it’s the cleaning process room and the items used are non-flammable, we need to conduct an investigation first.” (김기선 유성소방서장은 “(사고 지점이) 세척 공정실이고, 사용하는 물품들도 비인화성 물품들이라 조사를 해봐야 할 것 같다”고 했다.)

Chief Kim further explained, “This plant also had gunpowder explosion accidents in the past, in 2018 and 2019.” Minister of Employment and Labor Kim Young-hoon added, “Previously, explosions occurred during the fuel injection process, but this time, it has been reported that the explosion occurred for the first time in the final stage of the cleaning process.” (김 서장은 이어 “이 공장에서 과거에도 2018년, 2019년에 화약 (폭발) 사고가 있었다”고 설명했다. 김영훈 고용노동부 장관은 “이전에는 연료 주입 과정에서 폭발이 일어났는데, 이번에는 세척하는 과정의 마지막 단계에서 처음으로 (폭발이 일어난 것으로) 보고됐다”고 덧붙였다.)

Prime Minister Kim then inquired about the funeral preparation status. In response, Minister Kim stated, “We cannot identify which remains belong to whom,” adding, “We need to conduct a thorough DNA analysis.” An official from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety explained, “We expect the identification results to be available as early as tomorrow evening or the day after tomorrow.” (김 총리는 이어 장례 준비 상황을 물었다. 이에 대해 김 장관은 “(시신 각각이) 어느 분인지는 알 수 없다”며 “DNA 분석을 면밀하게 해야 한다”고 했다. 행정안전부 담당자는 “이르면 내일 저녁, 아니면 모레에 신원 확인 결과가 나올 것으로 예상한다”고 설명했다.)

Prime Minister Kim urged the Ministry of Employment and Labor, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, and local governments, “Please take good care of the bereaved families together, making sure they have no difficulties.” (김 총리는 노동부와 행안부, 지방자치단체에 “함께 유가족을 잘 모셔 주시고 어려움이 없도록 챙겨 달라”고 당부했다.)

Meanwhile, an official from the Ministry of the Interior and Safety reported, “Among the deceased, one had a father working here, and another had a son working here together.” That is, of the two victims, one was working alongside their father, and the other alongside their son at this plant when the accident occurred. (한편 행안부 담당자는 “돌아가신 분들 중에 한 분은 아버지, 한 분은 아들이 이곳에 같이 근무한다”고 보고했다. 사망자 2명 가운데 1명은 이 공장에서 아버지와 함께, 다른 1명은 아들과 함께 근무하다가 사고를 당했다는 것이다.)

The Prime Minister’s Office stated that Prime Minister Kim instructed the Ministry of Employment and Labor and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety to “thoroughly analyze this accident, clearly identify its cause, and promptly implement necessary improvement measures to prevent similar accidents from recurring.” (총리실은 김 총리가 노동부와 행안부에 “이번 사고를 철저히 분석해 원인을 명확하게 규명하고, 유사 사고가 재발하지 않도록 필요한 개선 조치를 신속히 추진하라”고 지시했다고 밝혔다.)

It also conveyed that Prime Minister Kim urged, “All workplaces should move beyond merely following safety rules in a perfunctory manner and thoroughly operate a field-centered safety prevention system that works in practice.” (또 김 총리가 “모든 사업장은 형식적인 안전 수칙 준수에서 벗어나, 실질적으로 작동하는 현장 중심의 안전 예방 체계를 철저히 가동해 달라”고 당부했다고 전했다.)

Earlier, at around 10:59 a.m. that day, an explosion and fire occurred at the Hanwha Aerospace Daejeon plant, resulting in five deaths and two injuries. One of the two injured individuals is reported to be in critical condition. This plant is a facility that produces equipment related to the aviation, defense, and space industries. (앞서 이날 오전 10시 59분쯤 한화에어로스페이스 대전사업장에서 폭발과 화재가 일어나 5명이 숨지고 2명이 다쳤다. 부상자 2명 가운데 1명은 중태인 것으로 전해졌다. 이 공장은 항공·방산·우주 산업 관련 장비를 생산하는 시설이다.)

item.title: Korea-Africa Foreign Ministers "Strengthen Cooperation on Maritime Routes and Critical Minerals" (韓·아프리카 외교장관 “해상운송로·핵심광물 협력 강화”)
item.description:
Korea-Africa Foreign Ministers "Strengthen Cooperation on Maritime Routes and Critical Minerals" (韓·아프리카 외교장관 “해상운송로·핵심광물 협력 강화”)

The foreign ministers of South Korea and African nations adopted a joint statement in Seoul on the 1st, expressing their commitment to expanding cooperation between the two sides. (한·아프리카 외교장관들이 1일 서울에서 양측의 협력 확대 의지를 담은 공동성명을 채택했다.)

Foreign ministers and vice ministers from various African countries, heads of four regional international organizations, and South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul held the "2026 Korea-Africa Foreign Ministers' Meeting" at Lotte Hotel in Jung-gu, Seoul on that day. (아프리카 각국의 외교 장·차관, 역내 4개 국제기구 수장, 조현 외교부 장관 등은 이날 서울 중구 롯데호텔에서 ’2026 한-아프리카 외교장관회의’를 개최했다.)

In the joint statement released after the meeting, they stated that they discussed "geopolitical instability, the current situations in Ukraine and the Middle East, and their impact on the global economy, particularly Africa and South Korea." (이들은 회의 후 발표한 공동성명에서 “지정학적 불안정, 우크라이나와 중동의 현 상황, 그리고 그것이 세계 경제와 특히 아프리카 및 한국에 미치는 영향” 등을 논의했다고 밝혔다.)

They noted, "The strategic importance of Africa is increasingly growing, including in terms of maritime transport routes and resources such as critical minerals," adding, "We assessed this as a valuable opportunity to deepen and strengthen the relationship between both sides (Korea and Africa)." They also stated, "Recognizing the potential for cooperation between South Korea and Africa, we confirmed the need to enhance mutually beneficial economic cooperation." (그러면서 “해상 운송로와 핵심 광물을 포함한 자원 측면에서 아프리카의 전략적 중요성이 점차 증대되고 있다”며 “우리는 이를 양측(한-아프리카) 관계를 심화·강화할 소중한 기회로 평가했다”고 밝혔다. 또 “한국과 아프리카 간 협력의 잠재력을 인식하며, 상호 호혜적인 경제협력을 강화할 필요성을 확인했다”고 했다.)

In the statement, they reaffirmed their commitment to implementing the outcomes of the "Korea-Africa Summit" held in South Korea in June 2024 and welcomed South Korea's proposal to host the "2029 Korea-Africa Summit." (성명에서 이들은 2024년 6월 한국에서 개최됐던 ‘한국 아프리카 정상회의’의 성과를 이행하겠다는 의지를 재확인하고, 한국의 ’2029년 한국-아프리카 정상회의' 개최 제안도 환영했다.)

The meeting was held with the participation of diplomatic representatives from 50 African countries and heads of four regional international organizations, including the African Union (AU), the African Development Bank (AfDB), the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA), and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC). (이번 회의는 아프리카 50국의 외교 대표자들과 아프리카연합(AU), 아프리카개발은행(AfDB), 아프리카대륙자유무역지대(AfCFTA), 아프리카 질병통제예방센터(아프리카 CDC) 등 역내 4개 국제기구 수장 등이 참석한 가운데 진행됐다.)

This marks the first time the government has invited all African countries and regional organizations to host a foreign ministers' meeting. Held under the theme "Korea-Africa Partnership for Joint Response in the Era of Global Transition," participants extensively discussed ways to strengthen cooperation between South Korea and Africa. (정부가 전체 아프리카 국가와 지역기구를 초청해 외교장관회의를 개최한 것은 이번이 처음이다. ‘글로벌 전환기 속 공동 대응을 위한 한-아프리카 파트너십’을 주제로 열린 이번 회의에서 참석자들은 한국과 아프리카의 협력 강화 방안을 광범위하게 논의했다.)

In his opening remarks, Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul said, "The world is facing complex challenges in various areas such as supply chains, energy, and food security," and stressed, "Close cooperation between Korea and Africa is more important than ever." (조현 외교부 장관은 이날 개회사에서 “세계가 공급망, 에너지, 식량안보 등 다양한 분야에서 복합적 도전에 직면하고 있다”며 “한-아프리카의 긴밀한 협력은 어느 때보다 중요하다”고 했다.)

Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, Minister for Foreign Affairs of Ghana—which serves as this year's vice chair of the African Union (AU) and co-chaired the meeting—stated, "Africa and South Korea have complementary strengths and enormous potential for mutually beneficial cooperation." (회의를 공동 주재한 올해 아프리카연합(AU) 부의장국 가나의 사무엘 오쿠제토 아블라콰 외교장관은 “아프리카와 한국은 상호 보완적인 강점을 갖고 있으며 상호 이익이 되는 협력에서 막대한 잠재력이 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Controversy Over Same-Sex Marriage in Anti-Discrimination Law... Government Initiates Legislation (동성혼 논란된 차별금지법... 정부, 법제화 시동 걸었다)
item.description:
Controversy Over Same-Sex Marriage in Anti-Discrimination Law... Government Initiates Legislation (동성혼 논란된 차별금지법... 정부, 법제화 시동 걸었다)

The government has announced plans to investigate overseas cases of anti-discrimination law enforcement and, based on this, draft legislation prohibiting hate speech and discrimination. The anti-discrimination law is a bill that prohibits all forms of discrimination based on gender, disability, sexual identity, and other categories. (정부가 해외의 차별 금지법 시행 사례를 조사하고, 이를 토대로 혐오 표현과 차별을 금지하는 내용의 법령을 마련하겠다고 밝혔다. 차별금지법은 성별, 장애, 성적 정체성 등 모든 분야에서 모든 차별을 금지하는 내용의 법안이다.)

According to "The Path of Great Transition Created by the People," a publication marking the first anniversary of the Lee Jae-myung administration that outlines national achievements and future reform tasks, the government has decided to actively pursue legislation for an anti-discrimination law as part of realizing "an advanced human rights country where everyone's dignity and rights are guaranteed," one of 123 national tasks. The achievements report states, "We aim to lay the groundwork for legislating against hate speech and discrimination by actively monitoring legislative proposals for the Equality Act (Anti-Discrimination Law) in the National Assembly and conducting 'surveys on the implementation cases and impacts of overseas anti-discrimination legal systems.'" <<> Progressive civic groups argue that, in the wake of the controversy over Starbucks' 'Tank Day' marketing, an anti-discrimination law should be enacted to regulate hate and discrimination. They contend that piecemeal measures, such as shutting down Ilbe, are insufficient and that a legal foundation must be established. <<> In contrast, religious circles oppose it, claiming it "legalizes same-sex marriage." Protestant groups argue that if the anti-discrimination law is introduced, merely criticizing homosexuality could lead to punishment, infringing on religious freedom. They also assert that including sexual orientation and gender identity as grounds for non-discrimination risks destroying the gender order and family structure. <<> The anti-discrimination law has faced legislative attempts since the Ministry of Justice first announced it in 2007, but these have failed due to opposition from religious groups. The core of the law prohibits discriminatory acts based on gender, disability, age, sexual orientation, education, religion, national origin, and employment type. In the 21st National Assembly, a bill including provisions on sexual orientation sparked intense controversy. A ruling party official said, "Given that the anti-discrimination law is a sensitive issue, we should start with reviewing overseas cases and take a long-term perspective." <<> Meanwhile, according to the achievements report, the government plans to submit an amendment to the 'Board of Audit and Inspection Act' to the National Assembly in the first half of this year, aimed at strengthening control over the audit office's secretariat to enhance the political neutrality and independence of the Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI). The report states, "We plan to submit the amendment in the first half of the year to strengthen the Audit Committee's control over the secretariat, revise the 'Public Audit Standards,' and legislate pre-audit consulting to improve public audit quality and foster a proactive administrative culture in the public sector." <<> Additionally, to fully address historical issues, efforts will include supporting the restoration of honor for victims of the No Gun Ri incident and verifying the list of the Ukishima Maru. The government said, "We will strive to ensure that in 2026, operations of the No Gun Ri Peace Park, various memorial projects, and trauma healing activities for victims proceed," adding, "We will continue to resolve historical issues and lay the foundation for a unified society through trauma healing activities in the Jeonnam region, support for restoring the honor of No Gun Ri victims, the launch of the Kanto Committee, and verification of the Ukishima Maru list." <<> A 'second public institution relocation plan' for balanced development is also set to be established within this year. Additionally, the construction of the Gadeokdo New Airport is in the basic design phase (March–September 2026), with the goal of starting construction on the priority portion by the end of 2026. The Daegu-Gyeongbuk Integrated New Airport, the first domestic case of simultaneously relocating civilian and military airports, will prepare for integrated civilian-military design and construction to prevent redundant investment in shared facilities. <<> This achievements report highlights 38 key accomplishments from the first year of the Lee Jae-myung administration, focusing on the economy, industry, diplomacy, and public welfare. It cites the KOSPI surpassing 8,000 points, exports exceeding $700 billion, and a 99% reduction in wildfire damage area as major outcomes. (이재명 정부가 출범 1년을 맞아 국정 성과와 향후 개혁 과제를 담아 펴낸 ‘국민이 만든 대전환의 길’에 따르면, 정부는 123대 국정 과제 중 하나인 ‘모두의 존엄과 권리가 보장되는 인권 선진국’ 실현을 위해 본격적으로 차별금지법 입법에 나서기로 했다. 성과집은 “평등법(차별금지법) 국회 입법 발의에 대한 적극적인 모니터링과 ’해외 차별 금지법제의 시행 사례 및 영향 실태 조사‘를 추진하면서 혐오 표현과 차별 방지 법제화를 위한 토대를 마련하고자 한다”고 밝혔다.)
