item.title: D-2 Gyeongnam Governor Election Heats Up with Allegations of Deepfake Videos and Election Interference (D-2 경남도지사 선거, ‘딥페이크 영상·관권선거 의혹’ 공방 격화)
item.description:
D-2 Gyeongnam Governor Election Heats Up with Allegations of Deepfake Videos and Election Interference (D-2 경남도지사 선거, ‘딥페이크 영상·관권선거 의혹’ 공방 격화)

With two days left until voting day, the June 3 local elections for Gyeongnam governor are intensifying as the ruling and opposition parties clash over allegations of "deepfake video production and distribution" and "election interference involving public officials." The Democratic Party of Korea is launching an offensive, claiming "organized election interference with civil servant involvement," while the People Power Party counters by calling it "political manipulation." Both sides are filing complaints against each other, engaging in a war of truth, and with a whistleblower even stepping forward, the dispute is devolving into a mudslinging match. <<> On the 1st, Democratic Party candidate Kim's spokesperson, Kim Myeong-seop, held a press conference at the Gyeongnam Provincial Government building, calling on the Changwon District Prosecutors' Office to swiftly secure evidence and investigate nine individuals—including former and current Gyeongnam provincial government employees and staff of candidate Park's election campaign—who were referred for investigation by the Gyeongnam Election Commission on suspicion of violating the Public Official Election Act. <<> Spokesperson Kim stated, "Nine people, including individuals linked to candidate Park's campaign and former and current public officials, were simultaneously referred by the Election Commission to the Changwon District Prosecutors' Office for investigation. This is truly an illegal election interference and AI fake video gate." He added, "Reports say the whistleblower not only informed the Election Commission about the production and distribution of fake videos but also about the operation of a mock election office. This whistleblower is not from our side but someone who was part of candidate Park's campaign." <<> In response, candidate Park Wan-soo's campaign senior spokesperson, Yoo Hae-nam, also held a press conference, fully refuting the allegations, claiming, "Candidate Kim's side is inflating baseless suspicions in the final stages of the election." <<> Spokesperson Yoo asserted, "Candidate Park's campaign never ordered the production of such videos, did not organize their distribution, and did not post them on the official YouTube channel." He also denied the existence of a "deepfake task force." He said, "Candidate Kim's side claims candidate Park's campaign produced and distributed deepfake videos. If there is even one piece of evidence video, present it. Candidate Kim's camp is hiding behind the whistleblower's one-sided claims and media reports, only fueling suspicions." <<> Regarding the filing of a complaint against the media outlet and reporter that reported on the allegations, he stated, "This is not intimidation of the press, but a legitimate legal measure to prevent voters' judgment from being clouded by the spread of false information." <<> Previously, on May 31, candidate Park's campaign stated, "We have criminally charged informant A, who spread false information as if we operated a deepfake-dedicated team and ordered the production and distribution of illegal deepfake videos, as well as the reporter who reported on this without verifying the facts." Spokesperson Yoo said, "We expect a comprehensive investigation through the prosecution's complaint, and once the investigation confirms the whistleblower's claims, we believe the suspicions will be resolved quickly." <<> This dispute was sparked on May 28, when a media outlet reported, "According to revelations by employee A, who worked for candidate Park Wan-soo's campaign, the campaign had dedicated personnel producing deepfake videos. In this process, AI deepfake videos defaming candidate Kim Gyeong-soo were produced and distributed, and there are indications that Gyeongnam provincial government employees were involved." <<> The Public Official Election Act prohibits the production, editing, and distribution of illegal AI fake videos for election campaign purposes from 90 days before the election. It also prohibits public officials from exerting undue influence or affecting election outcomes. <<> The Gyeongnam provincial government employees named by whistleblower A are fixed-term public servants in political roles, appointed during candidate Park's tenure as Gyeongnam governor. They resigned at the end of April when Park registered as a preliminary candidate and joined his campaign. One is reportedly still serving as a public official. If, before the end of April, they, as incumbent officials, instructed A to produce videos or provided materials, they may have violated the neutrality obligation of public servants in elections. <<> Following the report, candidate Kim's campaign filed a complaint with the Gyeongnam Provincial Police Agency on May 29 against candidate Park's campaign for alleged violations of the Public Official Election Act and the Local Public Officials Act. <<> As the dispute between the ruling and opposition parties turns into a mudslinging match, whistleblower A has also stepped forward. He held his own press conference that afternoon, introducing himself, "From April 14 to May 6, I worked on video production in candidate Park's campaign." A reportedly surrendered and reported to the Gyeongnam Provincial Election Commission on May 6, stating he was involved in illegal election activities. <<> He claimed, "On the evening of April 13, I received an external hard drive containing numerous videos from a car of a special advisor in Gyeongnam Province. It is clear that I was instructed to produce many videos around the time when one resigns as governor to engage in election activities." This implies he received materials from a public official. The hard drive A received reportedly contained videos and materials related to incumbent governor candidate Park Wan-soo, created by the Gyeongnam Provincial Government's Public Relations Office and Publicity Office from 2023 to 2026. <<> A stated that based on these materials, he produced one music video and 19 shorts while working in candidate Park's campaign. Among these, the music video utilized deepfake technology and is known to contain content defaming candidate Kim. However, A clarified, "The music video using deepfake was not directly ordered by candidate Park's campaign; I uploaded it to my personal YouTube channel and then took it down." <<> A also claimed that while he was not involved, another video production team produced and distributed numerous shorts using deepfake technology. He said, "Under the direction of former Gyeongnam provincial government employees and a company that can be seen as an external organization, they systematically operated a YouTube channel, posting and distributing 32 short-form videos from mid-March to April 28 that constitute deepfake content." <<> He added, "I apologize to the residents of the province and to candidate Kim Gyeong-soo, the victim, for obscuring the fair election process through my unwitting involvement." (투표일을 이틀 앞둔 6·3지방선거 경남도지사 선거가 여야의 ‘딥페이크 영상 제작 및 배포·관권선거 의혹’ 공방으로 격화되고 있다. 더불어민주당은 “공무원이 개입한 조직적 관권선거”라고 공세를 퍼붓고 있고, 국민의힘에서는 “정치공작”이라며 맞서는 상황이다. 양측이 서로를 고발하며, 진실 공방을 벌이는 상황에서 의혹 제보자까지 등판해 진흙탕 싸움으로 번지고 있다.)

item.title: Park Min-sik: "Han Dong-hoon’s Illegal Election Campaign"... Han Dong-hoon: "Park is Jang Dong-hyuk’s Avatar" (박민식 “韓, 불법 선거운동”... 한동훈 “朴, 장동혁 아바타”)
item.description:
Park Min-sik: "Han Dong-hoon’s Illegal Election Campaign"... Han Dong-hoon: "Park is Jang Dong-hyuk’s Avatar" (박민식 “韓, 불법 선거운동”... 한동훈 “朴, 장동혁 아바타”)

On May 1st, Park Min-sik, the People Power Party candidate, and Han Dong-hoon, an independent candidate, both running in the June 3rd by-election for Busan’s Buk-gu District, held separate press conferences and engaged in a war of words against each other. (6·3 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마한 국민의힘 박민식 후보와 무소속 한동훈 후보가 1일 각자 기자회견을 열고 서로를 향해 공방을 벌였다.)

Candidate Park Min-sik held a press conference at his election office at 3:30 PM that day, referencing the allegations of operating a 'quasi-campaign office' tied to candidate Han Dong-hoon. Earlier, the Busan Metropolitan Election Commission was reported to have requested a police investigation into whether the Public Official Election Act had been violated, concerning suspicions that individuals presumed to be supporters of Han had operated a quasi-campaign office under the guise of a 'volunteer rest area.' (박민식 후보는 이날 오후 3시 30분 선거사무소에서 기자회견을 열고 한동훈 후보와 관련해 제기된 ‘유사 선거사무소 운영 의혹’을 언급했다. 앞서 부산시선거관리위원회는 최근 한 후보의 지지자로 추정되는 인물들이 ‘자원봉사자 쉼터’라는 명목으로 유사 선거사무소를 운영했다는 의혹과 관련해 공직선거법 위반 여부를 판단하기 위해 경찰에 수사 의뢰를 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Candidate Park stated, "I understand there are various controversies surrounding candidate Han, including the rest area and chartered buses," and added, "Whether it's the Election Commission or the police, they must swiftly and actively investigate." He further said, "(Candidate Han) must clearly state whether it's true or false. Personally, I have rarely filed complaints or accusations during elections, but in cases like this, I believe a strong response is necessary." (박 후보는 “한 후보는 쉼터, 동원 버스 등 여러 논란이 있는 것으로 안다”며 “선거관리위원회든 경찰이든 신속하고 적극적으로 파악해야 한다”고 했다. 이어 그는 “(한 후보가) 아니면 아니다 기면 기라고 명명백백하게 밝혀줘야 한다”며 “개인적으로 선거 때 고소·고발을 해본 적이 거의 없는데 이런 경우는 따끔하게 대응해야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Park commented, "I feel daily that candidate Han’s (recent poll numbers showing) 40-something percent support are inflated with massive bubbles," and described Han as "someone who would use Buk-gu as a disposable fire starter for political ambition and then discard it." He then asserted, "Only I, Park Min-sik, have genuine sincerity for Buk-gu’s development," and vowed, "I will repay the fervent unity and aspirations of the conservative support base with certain victory." (박 후보는 “한 후보가 (최근 여론조사 결과 지지율이) 40 몇 퍼센트(를 기록)하는 게 엄청난 거품이 끼어있다는 것을 매일 체감한다”며 “정치적 야심을 위해 북구를 일회용 불쏘시개로 쓰고 내팽개칠 사람”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “북구 발전에 진정성을 가진 사람은 오직 저 박민식뿐”이라면서 “보수 지지층의 뜨거운 결집과 열망을 반드시 필승으로 보답하겠다”고 했다.)

In contrast, candidate Han Dong-hoon said at a press conference held at his election office at 3:00 PM that day, "President Lee Jae-myung sent his avatar directly to jump into this election, and Jang Dong-hyuk’s faction within the party has also put forward candidate Park Min-sik as their avatar," adding, "Only by overcoming both of these can Korea’s future exist." This was aimed at both Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and candidate Park. (반면 한동훈 후보는 이날 오후 3시 선거사무소에서 열린 기자회견에서 “이재명 대통령이 직접 아바타를 보내 이번 선거에 뛰어 들었고, 장동혁 당권파 역시 박민식 후보를 아바타로 내세웠다”며 “그 두 가지 모두를 극복해야만 대한민국의 미래가 있다”고 말했다. 더불어민주당 하정우 후보와 박 후보를 모두 겨냥한 것이다.)

Han stated, "The June 3rd by-election in Busan’s Buk-gu District is the opportunity to show the Democratic Party regime and the party faction (supporting Jang Dong-hyuk within the People Power Party) where the true public sentiment lies," and urged, "Please rally your votes for me so I can straighten the balance of Korea, where the right wing has been broken, and crush the rampage of the Lee Jae-myung regime." He also asked, "Who else in the National Assembly can fight and win against the 180 seats (of the Democratic Party) and stop excesses like the 'cancellation of indictment' (special counsel)?" (한 후보는 “민주당 정권과 (국민의힘에서 장동혁 대표를 지지하는) 당권파에게 진짜 민심이 어디에 있는지를 보여줄 기회가 바로 6월 3일 부산 북갑의 재·보궐선거”라면서 “오른쪽 날개가 꺾인 대한민국의 균형추를 맞춰 이재명 정권의 폭주를 박살 낼 수 있도록 제게 표를 몰아달라”고 했다. 그는 “누가 국회에 있어야만 (민주당 의석) 180석을 상대로 싸워서 이기고 ‘공소 취소’ (특검) 같은 폭주를 막을 수 있겠는가”라고도 했다.)

Regarding suspicions raised by some in the Democratic Party about "organized false address changes by Han Dong-hoon supporters," Han refuted, "They are firing off various slander circulating on online communities as if it’s a bygone-era election, and to avoid election laws, candidate Ha Jung-woo is using the party instead of doing it himself." (한 후보는 민주당 일각에서 ‘한동훈 후보 지지자들의 조직적 위장 전입’ 의혹이 제기된 데 대해 “마치 쌍팔년도 선거를 보듯이 커뮤니티에 떠도는 각종 마타도어를 선거 막판에 난사하고 있다”며 “선거법을 피하기 위해 하정우 후보가 직접 하지 않고 당을 이용하고 있다”고 반박했다.)

item.title: South Korea and US Hold First Meeting on Nuclear Submarine Introduction… Uranium Fuel Control is Key Issue (한미, 원잠 도입 첫 회의… 우라늄 연료 통제가 핵심 쟁점)
item.description:
The first meeting between South Korea and the United States to specifically discuss the implementation of security agreements reached during last year's summit—including the introduction of nuclear-powered submarines (SSNs), uranium enrichment, and securing spent nuclear fuel reprocessing rights—will be held in Seoul on the 2nd and 3rd. To stably receive US-made Low-Enriched Uranium (LEU) for submarine fuel, approved by the US administration and Congress, and to further secure independent enrichment and reprocessing rights, establishing a nuclear material control and management system to dispel concerns about "nuclear proliferation" appears to be the key. (한국의 원자력 추진 잠수함(원잠) 도입과 우라늄 농축, 사용후핵연료 재처리 권한 확보 등 지난해 한미 정상회담에서 도출된 안보 합의 사항의 이행 문제를 구체적으로 논의하기 위한 한미 간의 첫 회의가 2~3일 서울에서 열린다. 미 행정부와 의회의 승인을 얻어 원잠 연료로 쓰일 미국산 저농축 우라늄(LEU)을 안정적으로 공급받고 더 나아가 독자적인 농축·재처리 권한을 확보하려면, 일각의 ‘핵 확산’ 우려를 불식시킬 핵물질 통제 관리 체계의 구축이 관건이 될 것으로 보인다.)

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, an interagency delegation from both South Korea and the US will hold a kick-off meeting at 10 a.m. on the 2nd at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs building in Jongno-gu, Seoul, to discuss follow-up measures in the security sector of the South Korea-US summit joint fact sheet. For this purpose, U.S. Acting Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs Alison Hooker arrived in South Korea on the afternoon of the 1st, leading an interagency delegation comprising the State Department, Department of Energy, and Department of War (Department of Defense). Originally, the two countries were to start follow-up consultations early this year, but due to US issues with investments in America and Coupang, coupled with the US-Iran war, the first meeting was delayed by about six months. (외교부에 따르면, 한미 양국 범정부 대표단은 2일 오전 10시 서울 종로구 외교부 청사에서 한미 정상회담 조인트 팩트시트(공동 설명 자료) 안보 분야 후속 조치 협의를 위한 발족(Kick-off) 회의를 개최한다. 이를 위해 엘리슨 후커 미 국무부 정무차관이 국무부, 에너지부, 전쟁부(국방부) 등으로 이뤄진 범정부 대표단을 이끌고 1일 오후 방한했다. 당초 한미는 올해 초 후속 협의를 시작하기로 했지만, 미국이 대미 투자와 쿠팡 등을 문제 삼은 데다 미·이란 전쟁까지 겹치면서 약 6개월 만에 첫 회의가 열리게 됐다.)

The government has reportedly prepared the kick-off meeting to go beyond a mere introductory gathering. A diplomatic source said, "Both countries strongly intend to produce initial results before the US midterm elections in November, so there is a high possibility of announcing the regularization of meetings for continuous follow-up consultations." It is understood that options are being reviewed for the South Korean and US delegations to regularly travel between the two countries and hold video conferences as needed. (정부는 발족회의가 상견례에 그치지 않도록 준비해온 것으로 알려졌다. 외교 소식통은 “양국 모두 11월 미국의 중간선거 전까지 1차 결과물을 도출한다는 의지가 강해 지속적 후속 협의를 위해 회의 정례화를 발표할 가능성이 크다”고 했다. 한미 대표단이 정기적으로 양국을 오가면서 수시로 화상 회의를 하는 방안이 검토되는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Our government has already stated multiple times that it will not develop nuclear weapons even after introducing SSNs and securing enrichment and reprocessing rights, and that it will strictly adhere to the international community's nuclear non-proliferation principles. In the South Korea-US consultations, legal and technical details are expected to be discussed on how to ensure these principles are actually upheld and that the nuclear materials South Korea acquires are not diverted for nuclear weapons development. In particular, unlike nuclear power plants, which are accessible to international inspection teams at any time, once an SSN sets sail, its location and route are classified, so nuclear material control within the SSN is likely to be a key topic of discussion. (우리 정부는 이미 여러 차례 원잠 도입과 농축·재처리 권한 확보 이후에도 핵무기를 개발하지 않고, 국제사회의 핵 비확산 원칙을 철저히 준수할 것이라는 입장을 밝혔다. 한미 협의에서는 그런 원칙이 실제로 지켜지고 한국이 획득할 핵물질이 핵무기 개발에 전용되지 않도록 어떻게 보장할 것인지 법적·기술적 세부 사항이 논의될 것으로 예상된다. 특히 언제든 국제사찰단의 접근이 가능한 원전과 달리 원잠은 한 번 출항하면 위치·동선이 기밀에 부쳐지므로, 원잠 내 핵물질 통제가 중점 논의될 가능성이 있다.)

The US domestic legal procedures that the government must follow to import "LEU under 20%," which it has stated will be used for SSN fuel, are also subject to consultation. Under the current South Korea-US nuclear agreement, South Korea cannot enrich uranium without US consent and imports all LEU used for nuclear power plant fuel. To conduct independent enrichment and reprocessing, the existing agreement needs to be amended. However, there is analysis that the current agreement only stipulates "peaceful uses" such as nuclear power generation, and a separate agreement is needed for the transfer of SSN fuel, which falls under "military purposes." Australia, which is building SSNs through a trilateral partnership with the US and the UK, signed a "Naval Nuclear Propulsion Agreement" with the US in 2024. (정부가 원잠 연료로 쓰겠다고 밝힌 ‘20% 미만 저농축 우라늄’의 수입을 위해 밟아야 할 미국 국내법적 절차도 협의 대상이다. 현행 한미 원자력 협정에 따라 한국은 미국의 동의 없이 우라늄을 농축할 수 없고, 원전 연료로 쓰이는 저농축 우라늄도 전량 수입하고 있다. 독자적 농축·재처리를 하려면 기존 협정 개정이 필요하다. 그런데 기존 협정은 원자력 발전 등 ‘평화적 이용’만 규정하는 것으로, ‘군사적 용도’에 해당하는 원잠 연료 이전에는 별도의 협정이 필요하다는 분석이 나온다. 미국·영국과의 삼자 파트너십을 통해 원잠을 건조하기로 한 호주는 2024년 미국과 ‘해군 핵 추진 협정’을 체결했다.)

Attention is also focusing on whether the US side will demand enhanced military cooperation, with an eye on containing China, in return for supporting the SSN introduction. On the 26th of last month, the Ministry of National Defense announced the "Jang Bogo N Project" to deploy Korean-style SSNs in the 2030s, stating they would "play a key role in responding to North Korea's submarine-based nuclear and missile threats." This is presented as a "deterrence against North Korea." Meanwhile, US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth said at the Asia Security Conference held in Singapore on the 30th of last month, regarding South Korea's SSN introduction, that it "could present a real dilemma to potential adversaries who are curious about the extent of our capabilities." This remark was interpreted as targeting China. (미국 측이 원잠 도입을 지원하는 대가로 대중 견제 등을 염두에 둔 군사 협력 강화를 요구할지도 주목된다. 지난달 26일 국방부는 2030년대 한국형 원잠을 전력화한다는 ‘장보고 N 사업’을 발표하며 “북한의 잠수함 기반 핵·미사일 위협 등에 대응하는 핵심적인 역할을 하게 될 것”이라고 했다. ‘대북 억제용’이라는 것이다. 반면 피트 헤그세스 미 전쟁부(국방부) 장관은 지난달 30일 싱가포르에서 열린 아시아안보회의에서 한국의 원잠 도입과 관련해 “우리의 역량이 어느 정도인지 궁금해하는 잠재적 적국에 실질적인 딜레마를 안겨줄 수 있다”고 말했다. 중국을 겨냥한 것으로 해석되는 발언이었다.)

The US Atomic Energy Act allows the US President to authorize the sale or transfer of nuclear materials for military purposes if he "determines that it would promote the common defense and security and would not constitute an unreasonable risk" and there is no congressional objection. However, there is a condition that the recipient country must "be making substantial and significant contributions to mutual defense and security together with the United States under international agreements." This could serve as a basis for the US to demand South Korea's participation in containing China regarding the SSN introduction. (미국 원자력법은 미국 대통령이 ‘공동 방위와 안보를 증진하고 불합리한 위험을 야기하지 않는다고 판단’하고 의회의 반대가 없으면, 군사적 용도로 핵 물질을 판매·이전하는 것을 허용하고 있다. 다만 그 대상이 되는 국가가 ‘국제적 협정에 따라 미국과 함께 상호 방위 및 안보를 위해 실질적이고 중대한 기여를 하고 있는 경우’여야 한다는 단서가 있다. 미국이 원잠 도입과 관련해 대중 견제 동참을 요구할 근거가 될 수 있다.)

item.title: Xi Jinping’s Visit to North Korea Imminent? Structure Believed to Be a Reviewing Stand Being Set Up at Kim Il-sung Square (시진핑 방북 임박했나… 사열대 추정 구조물, 김일성 광장에 설치중)
item.description:
Amid speculation that Chinese President Xi Jinping may visit North Korea, the U.S.-based North Korea specialist outlet NK News reported that the North is constructing a structure believed to be a reviewing stand at Pyongyang’s Kim Il-sung Square. North Korea has previously set up temporary reviewing stands for welcoming ceremonies for foreign dignitaries, such as Russian President Vladimir Putin, fueling speculation that Chairman Xi’s visit may be imminent. However, some sources suggest that early June may be difficult given China’s diplomatic schedule, including the visit of the Lao president to China from the 2nd to the 6th. (시진핑 중국 국가주석의 방북 가능성이 제기된 가운데, 북한이 평양 김일성 광장에 사열대로 추정되는 구조물을 짓고 있다고 미국의 북한 전문 매체 ‘NK뉴스’가 최근 보도했다. 북한은 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령 등 외국 주요 인사를 맞는 환영식 때 사열대를 임시로 설치해와 시 주석의 방북이 임박한 것 아니냐는 추측이 나오고 있다. 다만 라오스 국가주석 방중(2~6일) 증 중국 측 외교 일정을 고려할 때 6월 초는 쉽지 않다는 이야기도 나온다.)

NK News analyzed a video taken in Pyongyang on May 26-27 by Singaporean Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan during his visit to North Korea, reporting that a tall screen and a mobile crane were seen surrounding some structure inside Kim Il-sung Square. Using satellite imagery to pinpoint the screen’s location, the outlet found it matched the spot where a temporary stone reviewing stand had been erected for the welcoming ceremony during President Putin’s 2024 visit to North Korea. (NK뉴스는 지난달 26~27일 북한을 방문한 비비안 발라크리슈난 싱가포르 외교부 장관이 평양에서 촬영한 동영상을 분석해, 김일성 광장 내부에 어떤 구조물을 둘러싼 것으로 보이는 높은 가림막과 이동식 크레인의 모습이 확인된다고 전했다. 이 매체가 위성 사진을 이용해 가림막 위치를 분석해 보니, 2024년 푸틴 대통령 방북 당시 환영식에 쓰기 위해 임시로 설치했던 석조 사열대가 있던 자리였다.)

Since satellite images from May 24, two days before Balakrishnan’s visit, showed no such screen, NK News concluded that construction of the structure began in the interim. The outlet noted that the reviewing stand for Putin’s visit was installed eight days prior, suggesting that Chairman Xi could visit North Korea early this month. Recent satellite images of Pyongyang International Airport also reportedly show space prepared to accommodate multiple large aircraft, further indicating an imminent visit. (발라크리슈난 장관의 방북 이틀 전인 지난달 24일 위성 사진에는 가림막이 보이지 않았기 때문에, 그 사이에 구조물 설치 공사가 시작됐다는 것이 NK뉴스의 분석이다. 이 매체는 푸틴 대통령 방북 때 사열대 설치 작업은 방북 8일 전부터 시작됐다며, 이를 근거로 시 주석이 이달 초 방북할 가능성이 있다고 전했다. 최근 평양 국제공항을 찍은 위성 사진에서도 대형 항공기 여러 대를 수용할 수 있는 공간이 마련된 모습이 포착됐다고 한다. 이 역시 시 주석 방북이 임박한 정황이라는 것이다.)

Earlier, the U.S. news magazine Time reported on May 20, citing an anonymous source, that Chairman Xi plans to pay a state visit to North Korea soon. South Korea’s government is also said to have obtained intelligence on the possibility of Xi’s visit and is closely monitoring related developments. According to diplomatic sources, the North Korean embassy in Beijing received orders from Pyongyang to “arrange a summit with Chairman Xi,” after which the International Department of the Chinese Communist Party reportedly conducted an inspection visit to Pyongyang. (앞서 미국 시사 주간지 타임은 지난달 20일 익명 소식통을 인용해 시 주석이 조만간 북한을 국빈 방문할 예정이라고 보도했다. 우리 정부도 시 주석의 방북 가능성에 대한 첩보를 입수하고 관련 동향을 예의 주시 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 외교 소식통에 따르면 평양에서 베이징의 북한 대사관에 ‘시 주석과의 정상회담을 성사시키라’는 지령을 하달했고, 그 후 중국 공산당 대외연락부가 평양을 답사한 것으로 알려졌다.)

If Chairman Xi visits North Korea, it could be seen as a return visit for North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un’s attendance at last year’s Chinese military parade marking the 80th anniversary of victory in the War of Resistance Against Japan. Following President Putin’s visit to China last month, it would also signify the consolidation of solidarity among North Korea, China, and Russia. (시 주석이 방북한다면 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 지난해 중국 항일전쟁 승리 80주년 열병식에 참석한 데 대한 답방 성격으로 볼 수 있다. 푸틴 대통령이 지난달 중국을 방문한 데 이어, 북·중·러 간 연대가 공고화되는 의미도 있다.)

item.title: Security Experts Say "North Korea Promotes Hostile Two-State Theory to Threaten South Korea with Nuclear Weapons" (안보 전문가들 “北, 한국 핵 위협하려 적대적 두 국가론 내세워”)
item.description:
Concerns have been raised that if South Korea acknowledges a "two-state relationship" between the two Koreas, it could strengthen North Korea's "hostile two-state theory" and intensify its threats against the South. Park Hyeong-jung, a former senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, made this statement at a conference held on the 1st by the Unification and Sharing Foundation at the Press Center in Jung-gu, Seoul, under the theme "Era of Turmoil—How to Reunite Unification and Peace." He described "North Korea's hostile two-state theory as a strategy for permanent coexistence on the Korean Peninsula with North Korea holding the upper hand." <<> In his presentation, Park stated, "Even if South Korea discards its unification discourse or transforms inter-Korean relations into a two-state relationship, North Korea will not abandon its hostile two-state theory or change inter-Korean relations to one of 'peaceful coexistence.'" He added, "The notion that if we offer goodwill first for peace, the other side will reciprocate with goodwill is a delusion that invites danger." He argued, "Even if we recognize the two Koreas as two states and refer to (North Korea's) official name, the structurally inherent hostility between the two sides, along with the institutional systems and interests that internalize it, will not budge at all." Recently, Unification Minister Kim Yung-ho and others have claimed that the two Koreas are effectively in a two-state situation and have urged referring to North Korea as the "Democratic People's Republic of Korea." <<> However, Park emphasized that North Korea's hostile two-state theory is "not simply a declaration of abandoning unification but an ideological preparation for implementing a nuclear coercion strategy against South Korea." He noted, "As long as the unification narrative is maintained, South Korea remains not just an enemy but part of a people to be reunified someday, which burdens North Korea's internal control." Therefore, he argued, "The hostile two-state theory is an attempt to block South Korea's absorptive gravitational appeal by reclassifying South Korea as an adversary rather than compatriots." <<> Kim Byung-yeon, a distinguished professor at Seoul National University, suggested on the same day, "I propose that integration, rather than unification or peace, be set as the goal of our government's North Korea policy." Professor Kim stated, "Let us define the process of inter-Korean relations in three stages—economic cooperation, economic integration, and unification—and tentatively pursue economic integration as a policy goal." He added, "A political system similar to the second stage of the national community unification plan, such as a confederation or a lower-level federation, is unrealistic." <<> Professor Emeritus Park Myung-kyu of Seoul National University said, "A simple coexistence theory not connected to unification cannot guarantee stable peace," and stressed that "unification and peace should be reconstructed as complementary rather than substitutive relationships." Professor Emeritus Cho Dong-ho of Ewha Womans University noted, "A dichotomous perspective of being for or against unification cannot capture the complex attitudes of the public or the complexity of the issue." He added, "We should not narrow our view just because the younger generation's perception of unification has weakened; instead, we must expand experiences and education about unification from a long-term perspective." (우리 측이 ‘남북 두 국가 관계’를 인정하면 북한의 ‘적대적 두 국가론’과 대남 위협을 강화하는 결과로 이어질 수 있다는 지적이 제기됐다. 박형중 전 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 1일 서울 중구 프레스센터에서 통일과나눔 재단이 ‘격동의 시대-통일과 평화 어떻게 재결합할 것인가’를 주제로 개최한 콘퍼런스에서 “북한의 적대적 두 국가론은 북한 우위의 남북 영구 병존 전략”이라며 이렇게 말했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok 'Likes' Post Criticizing Jeong Cheong-rae... Party Leadership Struggle Already Underway (정청래 비판글에 ‘좋아요’ 누른 김민석… 벌써 당권 싸움)
item.description:
Internal strife over the next party leadership is already brewing within the Democratic Party of Korea, even before the June 3 local elections have concluded. With Representative Jeong Cheong-rae's bid for re-election as party leader virtually certain, rumors that Prime Minister Kim Min-seok will resign from his post immediately after the local elections and run for party leader have split supporters of Representative Jeong and Prime Minister Kim into two camps, which are already engaged in a war of nerves. (더불어민주당에서 6·3 지방선거가 끝나기도 전에 차기 당권을 둘러싼 내부 투쟁이 벌어지고 있다. 정청래 대표의 연임 도전이 확실시되는 가운데 김민석 국무총리의 지방선거 직후 총리직 사임 및 당대표 출마설이 나오면서 정 대표와 김 총리 지지 세력이 둘로 쪼개져 벌써부터 신경전을 벌이는 모양새다.)

Within the Democratic Party, the outcome of the North Jeolla Province gubernatorial election is seen as having a major impact on the race for the next party leadership. North Jeolla is witnessing a tight race between Lee Won-taek, the Democratic Party candidate backed by the pro-Jeong faction, and independent candidate Kim Kwan-young. After being expelled from the Democratic Party over the "proxy payment controversy," candidate Kim has argued, "Representative Jeong had me expelled to install a pro-Jeong candidate in order to secure his own re-election as party leader," adding, "If I am elected, Representative Jeong must resign from his position as party leader." If candidate Kim is indeed elected, it would mark the first time an independent has become a metropolitan government head in the Honam region, inevitably placing the responsibility for the nomination squarely on Representative Jeong. A Democratic Party official commented, "Even if we win in Seoul and Busan, losing in North Jeolla would be a very painful outcome for Representative Jeong, who is seeking re-election as party leader. That's precisely why the Jeong Cheong-rae leadership is going all out on the North Jeolla election until the very end, isn't it?" <<> A clash of egos among contenders for the next party leadership is also taking shape over issues like the North Jeolla election. Former Representative Song Young-gil, who is rumored to be running for party leader, criticized Representative Jeong on YouTube on the 30th, stating, "Kim Kwan-young is someone President Lee chose. It's a contradiction for the Democratic Party to concentrate its party resources in North Jeolla (to get candidate Lee Won-taek elected)." The Jeong Cheong-rae leadership had previously stated on multiple occasions that "supporting candidate Kim constitutes an act of violating party rules." However, pro-Myung figures, including former Representative Song, are arguing, "If the Democratic Party loses in North Jeolla, Representative Jeong should take responsibility." Pro-government YouTuber Kim Eo-joon, who is close to Representative Jeong, mentioned former Representative Song on his YouTube channel on the 1st, saying, "That person seems to be 'pro-seok (pro-Kim Min-seok).'" He added, "Pro-Myung and anti-Myung are frames created by the conservatives; the real division is whether you're pro-Jeong Cheong-rae or pro-Kim Min-seok." <<> It recently came to light that Prime Minister Kim had 'liked' a Facebook post from the 28th by pro-government YouTuber Kim Yong-min, which read, "Jeong Cheong-rae, who can't even properly protect the candidates he nominated, should remember that there will be 'no next time' for him either." After this caused controversy among pro-Jeong party members, Prime Minister Kim canceled the 'like.' A ruling camp official noted, "There has been widespread talk that Kim Eo-joon already backed Representative Jeong in the last party leadership election, and he has even clashed with Prime Minister Kim over issues like opinion polls since then. The situation is that pro-government YouTubers are also splitting into pro-Jeong factions supporting Representative Jeong and pro-Myung factions backing Prime Minister Kim, fighting each other over the party leadership." <<> The Democratic Party is anticipating a party leadership race involving Representative Jeong, Prime Minister Kim, and former Representative Song. The party's national convention is expected to be held as early as late August or as late as early September. Prime Minister Kim is reportedly planning to resign as Prime Minister within June, after the local elections end, and officially announce his candidacy for party leader. Ahead of this, Prime Minister Kim has been increasing his contacts with Democratic Party lawmakers. He is also scheduled to have a dinner with state ministers on the 2nd, the day before the local elections. Within the ruling camp, there is talk that "if Prime Minister Kim decides to run for party leader, the next party leadership race will ultimately become a fight between the pro-Jeong and pro-Myung factions." <<> With Prime Minister Kim's resignation looming, speculation about his successor is also emerging. Names being mentioned include Chief of Staff to the President Kang Hoon-sik, Minister of Justice Chung Sung-ho, Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jung-kwan, Senior Presidential Secretary for Policy Kim Yong-bum, and Democratic Party lawmaker Han Jung-ae. A key pro-Myung figure commented, "President Lee Jae-myung wants to deliver results on the six major structural reforms announced last year, such as those on labor and pensions, starting next year when there are no elections. Since there will be opposition from both the ruling and opposition parties, he is looking for the right person who can calmly push through these reforms despite criticism." President Lee is also expected to implement some changes in cabinet ministers, presidential chief of staff, and senior secretaries in conjunction with the appointment of the new prime minister. (민주당에선 이번 전북지사 선거 결과가 차기 당권 경쟁에 큰 영향을 미칠 것으로 보고 있다. 전북은 친청계 민주당 이원택 후보와 무소속 김관영 후보 간 초접전 대결로 치러지고 있다. 김 후보는 ‘대리비 지급 논란’으로 민주당에서 제명된 뒤 “정 대표가 당대표 연임을 위해 친청계를 후보로 앉히려 나를 제명했다”며 “내가 당선되면 정 대표는 당대표직에서 사퇴해야 한다”고 해왔다. 실제 김 후보가 당선되면 호남에서 무소속 광역단체장이 나오는 첫 사례로, 정 대표로서는 공천 책임론이 나올 수밖에 없다. 민주당 관계자는 “서울, 부산을 다 이겨도 전북에서 민주당이 진다면 당대표 연임에 나서는 정 대표로선 매우 뼈아픈 결과일 것”이라며 “그래서 막판까지 정청래 지도부가 전북 선거에 올인하는 것 아니겠느냐”고 했다.)

item.title: Why is early voting turnout low in Pyeongtaek, despite a tight race? (평택을 접전인데도 사전투표율 저조, 왜?)
item.description:
On the 1st, various interpretations emerged from political circles regarding the relatively low early voting turnout in the by-election for the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly seat. (경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거 사전투표율이 상대적으로 낮게 나온 것을 두고 1일 정치권에서 여러 해석이 나왔다.)

According to the National Election Commission, the early voting rate for the Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly by-election, held on the 29th and 30th, stood at 18.39%, which is 5.73 percentage points lower than the average early voting rate of 24.12% across 14 nationwide National Assembly by-elections. Typically, the Honam region has shown high early voting rates, while Yeongnam has shown lower rates. In the case of Pyeongtaek, during the 2022 local elections, the early voting rate was 15.88%, lower than the national average of 20.62%. (중앙선거관리위원회에 따르면, 지난 29~30일 치러진 평택을 국회의원 재선거 사전투표율은 18.39%로, 전국 14곳 국회의원 재·보궐선거 사전투표율 평균(24.12%)보다 5.73%포인트 낮았다. 통상 호남은 사전투표율이 높고 영남은 사전투표율이 낮은 경향을 보여왔다. 평택의 경우 2022년 지방선거 때 사전투표율 15.88%로 전국 평균(20.62%)보다 낮았다.)

However, some view that this by-election for a National Assembly seat drew greater interest than other areas, with candidates including Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party, Yoo Eui-dong of the People Power Party, Cho Kuk of the Rebuilding Korea Party, Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Party for Freedom and Innovation. Thus, it is seen as reflecting voter sentiment. By district, the early voting rate was lowest in Godeok-dong, where pro-government candidates have focused their efforts. This is a new town area with many young voters working at nearby large corporations. In contrast, Paengseong-eup, which is the hometown of candidate Yoo and has a strong conservative leaning, showed a relatively higher rate. (다만 이번 국회의원 재선거에는 더불어민주당 김용남, 국민의힘 유의동, 조국혁신당 조국, 진보당 김재연, 자유와혁신 황교안 후보 등이 출마해 다른 지역보다 큰 관심을 받았기 때문에, 유권자 기류가 반영된 것으로 보는 시각도 있다. 지역별로는 범여권 후보들이 공을 들여온 고덕동에서 사전투표율이 가장 낮았다. 인근 대기업에 다니는 젊은 유권자가 많은 신도시 지역이다. 반면 그에 비해 유 후보 고향이자 보수세가 강한 팽성읍은 그에 비해 높았다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Park Seong-joon said on a radio program on the 1st, "In Busan's North Gap district, the early voting rate was nearly 26%, but the low early voting rate in Pyeongtaek-eul indicates that the voter tendency is heavily conservative," adding, "This suggests that conservative voters are likely to participate more in the main voting." (박성준 민주당 의원은 1일 라디오에서 “부산 북갑은 사전투표율이 26% 가까이 나왔는데 평택을 사전투표율은 낮다는 것은 유권자 성향이 보수층이 높다는 것”이라며 “보수층이 본투표에 많이 참여할 가능성이 크다고 해석된다”고 했다.)

There is also an interpretation that the ongoing negative campaigning between candidates Kim Yong-nam and Cho Kuk, who had even discussed a possible unification, has left pro-government supporters undecided and feeling fatigued. A Democratic Party official stated, "There will likely be many voters who are still contemplating until the main voting day." (단일화 가능성까지 나왔던 김용남, 조국 후보 사이에서 네거티브 선거전이 계속되면서 여권 지지자들이 마음을 정하지 못하고 피로감을 느낀 것이라는 해석도 나온다. 민주당 한 관계자는 “본투표까지 고민하는 유권자가 많을 것”이라고 했다.)

However, some argue that the low early voting rate is due to the characteristics of the district, which is a mixed urban-rural area. A staff member from one candidate's camp said, "The eight towns, townships, and neighborhoods that cover a large area each have only one early voting station, making it difficult for people to participate in early voting," and added, "The conventional wisdom that a low early voting rate and a high main voting rate favor conservatives does not apply here." (다만 도농(都農) 복합 지역인 지역구 특성상 때문에 사전투표가 낮은 것이라는 의견도 있다. 한 후보 캠프 관계자는 “면적이 넓은 8개 읍·면·동에 사전투표소는 단 한 개씩만 있어 사전투표에 참여하기 어려운 환경”이라며 “사전투표율이 낮고 본투표율이 높으면 보수에 유리하다는 통념이 적용되지 않는다고 본다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ruling Party Issues Caution on Verbal Slips Amid "Baby Kiss" Backlash (“아기 뽀뽀” 역풍에 與, 입조심 주의보)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea issued a directive to all its members on the 1st, two days before the June 3 local elections, urging them to "thoroughly guard against inappropriate remarks and actions." This measure follows controversy the previous day when the party's candidate for Seoul's Yangcheon District mayor forced a kiss on a baby during a campaign rally. (더불어민주당은 6·3 지방선거를 이틀 앞둔 1일, 전 당원을 대상으로 “부적절한 언행과 행동을 철저히 경계하라”는 지침을 내렸다. 전날 민주당 서울 양천구청장 후보가 유세 중 아기에게 ‘뽀뽀’를 강요해 논란이 불거진 데 따른 조치다.)

The party's central election committee announced that it would operate an emergency 60-hour system from 6 a.m. on the 1st until 6 p.m. on the 3rd, when voting ends. In a notice, the committee stated, "We thoroughly guard against inappropriate remarks and actions that could appear complacent or arrogant," and "We will maintain a sense of urgency and approach the election campaign with earnest hearts until the very last moment." (민주당 중앙선대위는 이날 오전 6시부터 투표가 끝나는 3일 오후 6시까지 60시간 비상 가동 체제를 운영한다고 밝혔다. 중앙선대위는 공지를 통해 “자만하거나 오만하게 비칠 수 있는 부적절한 언행과 행동을 철저히 경계”하며 “마지막 순간까지 긴장감을 유지하며 간절한 마음으로 선거운동에 임한다”고 했다.)

The previous day, Woo Hyung-chan, the Democratic Party candidate for Yangcheon District mayor, caused controversy by saying "Give me a kiss" to a baby held by Seoul mayoral candidate Jung Won-oh. Woo apologized, calling it "a careless and thoughtless remark," and Jung also told reporters at Seoul Station after a rally, "I feel deeply responsible to ensure this does not happen again." (전날 우형찬 민주당 양천구청장 후보는 정원오 서울시장 후보가 안고 있던 아기에게 “뽀뽀 한번”이라고 말해 논란을 빚었다. 우 후보는 “부주의하고 경솔한 언행이었다”며 사과했고, 정 후보도 이날 서울역 유세 뒤 기자들과 만나 “재발되지 않아야 한다는 점에서 깊이 책임감을 느낀다”고 했다.)

On the 3rd of last month, party leader Chung Cheong-rae caused controversy in Busan by telling an elementary school girl to "call him oppa" while referring to Ha Jung-woo, the candidate for the Busan North Gap by-election. Both Chung and Ha apologized, but as the so-called "oppa controversy" backlash grew, Chung's leadership team was unable to actively support the Busan election afterward. A Democratic Party official said, "In the final stages of an election, policy competition often takes a backseat to individual candidates' verbal slips or unexpected incidents," adding, "Right now, it's more important to avoid mistakes than to create new issues." (지난달 3일 정청래 대표는 부산에서 초등학생 여아에게 하정우 부산 북갑 보궐선거 후보를 두고 “오빠라고 해보라”고 말해 논란이 되기도 했었다. 정 대표와 하 후보 모두 사과했지만 이른바 ‘오빠 논란’ 후폭풍이 커지자 정청래 지도부는 이후 부산 선거 지원에 적극 나서지 못하는 상황이 됐다. 민주당 관계자는 “선거 막판에는 정책 경쟁보다 후보 개인의 말실수나 예상치 못한 사건이 선거를 좌우하는 경우가 많다”며 “지금은 새로운 이슈를 만드는 것보다 실수하지 않는 것이 더 중요하다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party focused on attacking the Democratic Party's inappropriate remarks. Senior spokesman Park Sung-hoon said in a statement that day, "Using children as tools for 'vote-begging' is a bizarre and outdated political practice—this is the true face of the Democratic Party's so-called 'children's rights'." Spokesman Jo Yong-sool also criticized, "This isn't just a mistake; it's a problem with a low-quality political culture." (국민의힘은 민주당의 부적절한 발언을 집중 공격했다. 박성훈 수석대변인은 이날 논평에서 “아이들을 ‘표 구걸’의 도구로 삼는 기괴한 구태 정치, 이것이 민주당이 말하는 ‘아동 인권’의 민낯”이라고 했다. 조용술 대변인도 “실수가 아니라 질 나쁜 정치 문화의 문제”라고 비판했다.)

Following the explosion at the Hanwha Aerospace factory in Daejeon, both ruling and opposition parties simultaneously declared "quiet campaigning." The Democratic Party issued a press release stating, "We have urgently instructed all candidates and campaign teams nationwide to stop using campaign songs and synchronized dances, and to halt all rallies." The People Power Party also instructed all national candidates and campaign teams to refrain from using campaign songs and dancing. (여야는 이날 한화에어로스페이스 대전공장에서 폭발 사고가 발생하자 동시에 ‘조용한 유세’를 선언했다. 민주당은 언론 공지를 통해 “전국의 더불어민주당 후보와 캠프에 로고송 사용과 율동 금지는 물론 전국의 모든 후보에게 유세 중단을 긴급 지시했다”고 했다. 국민의힘도 전국 후보와 선거 캠프에 로고송 사용과 율동을 자제하라고 지시했다.)

item.title: Jeong Won-oh: “Seoul Discount Is Because of Oh”… Oh Se-hoon: “Jeong, a Puppet of Lee Jae-myung, Is Underqualified” (정원오 “서울 디스카운트는 吳 때문”… 오세훈 “이재명 허수아비 鄭, 함량미달”)
item.description:
With two days to go until the main voting day for the Seoul mayoral election, candidates from both parties appealed for support consolidation through walking campaigns across Seoul on the 1st. Democratic Party candidate Jeong Won-oh visited redevelopment unions in Gangnam-gu and Yongsan-gu, which have strong conservative tendencies, emphasizing development pledges, while People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon focused his campaign on northern areas with many pro-government supporters. <<> Candidate Jeong Won-oh campaigned that morning at Dongdaemun Cheongnyangni Fruit and Vegetable Market and Seoul Station. At a press conference in front of Seoul Station, he said, “Please rally support for Jeong Won-oh, who will support the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration from Seoul.” Jeong added, “The core of the Seoul Discount is the safety negligence, incompetence, and irresponsibility of Oh Se-hoon’s city administration as Seoul mayor.” <<> Regarding real estate policy, Jeong, as a ruling party candidate, vowed to push forward tailored policies such as redevelopment and reconstruction, private and public apartment supply, and jeonse/monthly rent support through cooperation with the government. That evening, he met with residents of the Eunma Apartment complex in Gangnam-gu, which is pursuing reconstruction, and the Yongsan-gu redevelopment union to explain his urban renewal development pledges. <<> Candidate Oh Se-hoon targeted Jeong that day, saying, “He is a puppet who can’t help but focus on aligning with President Lee Jae-myung’s agenda.” In response to Jeong’s claim of a “Seoul Discount” directed at him, Oh retorted, “The Seoul Discount is likely to truly begin when an underprepared and underqualified candidate becomes mayor of Seoul.” Oh focused his campaign that day on northern Seoul areas classified as tough districts, including Gangbuk-gu, Dobong-gu, Nowon-gu, and Jungnang-gu. <<> Former President Lee Myung-bak visited Seoul Forest in Seongdong-gu that morning, saying, “We need to elect a mayor and district chief who do their jobs well,” supporting Oh. Seoul Forest, opened in 2005, was a project during Lee’s tenure as Seoul mayor. Seongdong-gu is where Jeong Won-oh served as district chief. Lee remarked, “When Seoul Forest was being built, there were many opponents, but once it was completed, it became a wonderful park where all Seoul citizens can conveniently come and go.” <<> However, both candidates shifted to a “quiet campaign” after news of the explosion at Hanwha Aerospace’s Daejeon plant was reported that afternoon. Jeong canceled his scheduled vehicle campaign and met citizens on foot instead. Oh’s campaign also announced a ban on dance routines and campaign jingles. (서울시장 선거 본투표를 이틀 앞둔 1일 여야 후보는 서울 전역을 훑는 도보 유세로 지지층 결집을 호소했다. 더불어민주당 정원오 후보는 보수세가 강한 강남구와 용산구 재건축조합을 찾아 개발 공약을 강조했고, 국민의힘 오세훈 후보는 여권 지지층이 많은 강북 지역을 중심으로 유세를 펼쳤다.)

item.title: Government Moves to Legislate Against Hate Speech and Discrimination (정부, 혐오 표현·차별 방지 법제화 시동)
item.description:
The Lee Jae-myung administration has announced that it will investigate overseas cases of anti-discrimination laws and, based on this, push forward with legislation to prevent hate speech and discrimination. The anti-discrimination law aims to prohibit discriminatory acts based on gender, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, and other factors. (이재명 정부가 차별금지법에 대한 해외 사례를 조사하고 이를 토대로 혐오 표현과 차별 방지 법제화에 나서겠다고 밝혔다. 차별금지법은 성별·장애·나이·성적 지향·종교 등을 이유로 한 차별 행위를 금지하는 내용이다.)

In a report titled "The Path of Great Transformation Created by the People," which outlines national achievements and tasks, the government stated on the 1st, "We will actively monitor legislative proposals for the Equality Act (Anti-Discrimination Law) in the National Assembly and pursue a 'survey on the implementation cases and impact of overseas anti-discrimination legislation,' thereby laying the groundwork for legislating against hate speech and discrimination." (정부는 1일 국정 성과와 과제를 담아 펴낸 ‘국민이 만든 대전환의 길’에서 “평등법(차별금지법) 국회 입법 발의에 대한 적극적인 모니터링과 ’해외 차별 금지 법제의 시행 사례 및 영향 실태 조사‘를 추진하면서 혐오 표현과 차별 방지 법제화를 위한 토대를 마련하고자 한다”고 밝혔다.)

The anti-discrimination law was first proposed as a government-initiated bill during the Roh Moo-hyun administration in 2007 and has since been introduced multiple times through parliamentary initiatives. However, legislation has stalled due to opposition from the Christian community, which views it as a "same-sex marriage legalization bill." During his presidential campaign, President Lee Jae-myung expressed support for the necessity of an anti-discrimination law but reserved his position, citing the need for sufficient social consensus. (차별금지법은 2007년 노무현 정부 때 정부 입법 형태로 처음 발의된 이후 의원 입법으로 여러 번 발의됐다. 하지만 “동성혼 합법화 법안”이라는 기독교계의 반발로 입법이 이어지지 않았다. 이재명 대통령도 지난 대선 때 차별금지법에 대한 필요성엔 찬성하나 충분한 사회적 합의가 필요하다며 입장을 보류했었다.)

◇ "Even criticizing homosexuality could lead to punishment" — Religious groups strongly oppose the anti-discrimination law (◇“동성애 비판만으로도 처벌받는다” 종교계는 차별금지법 강력 반대)

The left-leaning camp has pressured the government, arguing that "President Lee Jae-myung has been neglecting the anti-discrimination law since his election." Although a bill has been proposed in the National Assembly led by the Party for Justice and Innovation, substantive discussions have yet to take place. The government's announcement that it will monitor overseas cases and the legislative situation in the National Assembly is seen as a step toward preparing for legislation. (좌파 진영에서는 “이재명 대통령이 당선 이후 차별금지법에 소홀하다”며 압박해왔다. 현재 국회엔 조국혁신당 주도로 법안이 발의돼 있지만 지금까지 제대로 된 논의는 이뤄지지 않고 있다. 정부가 해외 사례와 국회 입법 상황을 모니터링하겠다고 밝힌 것은 법제화 준비 단계로 넘어가는 과정으로 해석된다.)

In February this year, the government established a "Basic Plan for Preventing Hate and Discrimination" and held the "First Forum on Responding to Hate and Discrimination," bringing together civil society organizations, researchers, and stakeholders focused on migrants, disabilities, and sexual minorities. It also co-hosted the "First Debate on Criteria for Judging Hate Speech" with the National Assembly Research Service and collaborated with the private sector to study "Overseas Cases and Challenges in Responding to Hate Speech." The Ministry of the Interior and Safety has since gathered opinions on the findings. (정부는 올 2월 ‘혐오차별 방지 기본계획’을 수립하고, 이주·장애·성소수자 관련 시민사회단체와 연구자 등 각계 구성원들과 함께 참여하는 ‘혐오차별대응 1차 포럼’을 개최했다. 국회입법조사처와 공동으로 1차 ‘혐오 표현 판단 기준에 관한 토론회’를 개최했고, 민간과 함께 ‘해외 혐오 표현 대응 사례와 과제’를 연구하기도 했다. 행정안전부는 이 연구 결과에 대한 의견 수렴을 진행했다.)

A government official stated, "Because the anti-discrimination law could be socially controversial, it is necessary to thoroughly gather public opinion and closely examine overseas cases. It will not be enacted in a short period." (정부 관계자는 “차별금지법은 사회적으로 논란이 될 수 있기 때문에 충분히 여론을 수렴하고, 해외 사례 또한 면밀히 들여다볼 필요가 있다”며 “단시일 내 입법이 되는 건 아니다”라고 했다.)

The core of the anti-discrimination law prohibits discriminatory acts based on gender, disability, age, sexual orientation, educational background, religion, country of origin, and employment type. In the 21st National Assembly, a bill including provisions on sexual orientation sparked heated controversy. (차별금지법은 성별·장애·나이·성적 지향·학력·종교·출신 국가·고용 형태 등을 이유로 한 차별 행위를 금지하는 내용이 핵심인데, 21대 국회에서도 성적 지향 등의 항목도 포함된 법안이 발의돼 논란이 격해졌다.)

The Christian community argues that if the anti-discrimination law is introduced, merely criticizing homosexuality could lead to punishment, infringing on religious freedom. They also claim that including sexual orientation and gender identity as grounds for prohibiting discrimination could undermine the order of the sexes and the institution of the family. (기독교계는 차별금지법이 도입되면 동성애를 비판하는 것만으로도 처벌받는 등 신앙의 자유가 침해될 수 있고, 성적 지향과 성별 정체성이 차별 금지 사유에 포함돼 남녀 질서와 가정을 파괴할 위험이 있다고 주장한다.)

Meanwhile, civil society groups have linked the issue to recent controversies, such as the debate over closing the far-right website 'Ilbe' and Starbucks' 'Tank Day' marketing incident. They argue that beyond shutting down Ilbe, which hosts far-right posts, the government should enact an anti-discrimination law regulating all forms of hate and discrimination. (반면 시민단체 등은 최근 ‘일간베스트(일베)’ 사이트 폐쇄 논란과 스타벅스의 ‘탱크데이’ 마케팅 논란과 이 사안을 연계하고 있다. 극우 성향의 게시물이 올라오는 일베를 폐쇄하는 데서 나아가 모든 혐오와 차별을 규제할 수 있는 차별금지법을 제정해야 한다는 것이다.)

A ruling party official commented, "The anti-discrimination law is a sensitive issue. That's why the Lee Jae-myung administration is starting with a survey of overseas cases and looking at it from a long-term perspective." (여권 관계자는 “차별금지법은 민감한 의제”라며 “그래서 이재명 정부에서도 일단 해외 사례 조사부터 시작해 장기적으로 보자는 것”이라고 했다.)

Separately, the ruling party is preparing to propose an 'Ilbe Ban Law' soon. Since current information and communications network laws cannot be used to shut down Ilbe, the new law would establish a fresh legal basis. President Lee previously mentioned reviewing the closure of Ilbe on X (formerly Twitter) on the 24th of last month. He cited media reports that presumed Ilbe members insulted former President Roh Moo-hyun on the 23rd of last month at Bongha Village, where a memorial service was held. (이와 별도로 여권에서는 ‘일베 금지법’을 조만간 발의할 준비를 하고 있다. 현행 정보통신망법으로는 일베 폐쇄가 불가능하기 때문에 새롭게 근거를 만드는 내용으로 알려졌다. 앞서 이 대통령은 지난달 24일 X에서 ‘일베 폐쇄 검토’를 언급했다. 일베 회원으로 추정되는 이들이 지난달 23일 노무현 전 대통령의 추도식이 열린 봉하마을에서 노 전 대통령을 모욕하는 행위를 했다는 언론 보도를 이유로 들었다.)

President Lee stated, "Public debate and actual review seem necessary to allow measures such as closing sites that neglect or promote mockery and hate like Ilbe, punitive damages, and fines." His post garnered thousands of comments, with supporters saying, "Hate and mockery are not freedom of expression," and opponents arguing, "If it suits your taste, it's freedom of expression; if it doesn't, it's punishable — that's the beginning of dictatorship." The closure of Ilbe was previously the subject of a public petition during the Moon Jae-in administration in 2018, reviewed by the Blue House at the time, but it did not lead to an actual shutdown. (이 대통령은 “일베처럼 조롱·혐오를 방치·조장하는 사이트 폐쇄, 징벌 배상, 과징금 등 필요 조치를 허용하는 데 대한 공론화와 실제 검토가 필요해 보인다”고 했다. 이 대통령의 글에서는 “혐오와 조롱은 표현의 자유가 아니다”라는 찬성 댓글과 “입맛에 맞으면 표현의 자유이고 거스르면 처벌, 그것이 바로 독재의 시작”이라는 반대 댓글이 수천 개 달렸다. 일베 폐쇄는 지난 2018년 문재인 정부 때 국민 청원이 올라와 당시 청와대가 검토했지만 실제 폐쇄로 이어지지는 않았다.)

item.title: Fighting for Every Last Percent... Rival Parties Go All-Out on Eve of Local Elections (1%라도 더… 여야 ‘지방선거 D-1’ 총력전)
item.description:
On the first day of June, two days before the June 3 local elections, the rival parties launched their final all-out campaigns. The leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea toured regions, promising "budget support." The People Power Party apologized, saying "We fell short," while appealing, "Please allow us to check the reckless one-man rule of the Lee Jae-myung administration." (6·3 지방선거를 이틀 앞둔 1일 여야가 막판 총력전에 나섰다. 더불어민주당 지도부는 지역을 돌며 ‘예산 지원’을 약속했다. 국민의힘은 “우리가 부족했다”고 사과하면서 “이재명 정권의 독주를 견제할 수 있게 해달라”고 호소했다.)

At a party central election committee meeting held in Cheonan, South Chungcheong Province, Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae said, "The budget will be drawn up under the Lee Jae-myung administration and passed by the Democratic Party in the National Assembly," urging, "Please vote for candidate number one for a powerful ruling party and the stable governance of the Lee Jae-myung administration." During a campaign rally in Hongseong County, South Chungcheong Province on May 29, Chung stated, "(The government and ruling party) will unleash a budget bombshell to dazzlingly develop Hongseong." <<> People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok and policy committee chairman Jeong Jeom-sik held a press conference at the National Assembly that day, saying, "We are well aware that many see the People Power Party as lacking. We apologize and regret this." Floor leader Song added, "The authoritarian attitude of attempting to withdraw an indictment to cover up one person's crime by mobilizing power is the essence of the Lee Jae-myung regime," urging, "Please cast a vote for candidate number two to provide at least minimal checks on this arrogant power." <<> Initially, there were many predictions in political circles that the Democratic Party would achieve a landslide victory in these local elections. However, as the push for a special counsel law to investigate the "fabricated indictment" that could lead to the withdrawal of the indictment against President Lee Jae-myung gained traction, and the argument for checking the ruling power emerged, the Democratic Party is now emphasizing the stock market surge and promising regional budget support in its final campaign efforts. In contrast, the People Power Party is focusing on the special counsel law for fabricated indictments, the government-level boycott of Starbucks, and the burden on people's livelihoods from high prices and a high exchange rate. <<> ◇ Ruling Party: "Vote for Us, and We'll Provide Budget Bombshell Support"... Opposition: "Buying Votes with Taxpayer Money" <<> The Democratic Party leadership has been emphasizing "budget bombshells" during recent regional campaign rallies. On May 31, leader Chung Cheong-rae said in Geumsan, South Chungcheong Province, and Gurye, South Jeolla Province, "If you vote for the Democratic Party candidate, we will designate this area as a basic income region for farming and fishing communities." <<> The Lee Jae-myung administration is currently operating a basic income project for farming and fishing communities in 10 counties nationwide, distributing 150,000 won per month to all county residents for two years in the form of local gift certificates. Amid the so-called "war supplementary budget" due to the Iran situation, it was decided to select around five additional locations this year, and 44 areas applied. The Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs had previously stated it would form an evaluation committee centered on civilian experts to select the project areas. <<> Recently, the Democratic Party has also been promising "central party-level budget support" for local issues. When the Democratic Party candidate for mayor of Gyeryong promised to relocate the Gyeryong Spa Tel, a military resort facility previously used as a presidential lodging, from Daejeon to Gyeryong, leader Chung stated, "We will provide budget and institutional support at the central party level," which sparked backlash in Daejeon. Floor leader Han Byeong-do on May 30 promised large-scale budgets in Seosan, South Chungcheong Province, including support for the Daesan Industrial Complex and the opening of Seosan Airport. <<> President Lee Jae-myung also stated at a cabinet meeting on May 26, "To elevate the southeastern region into a global maritime economic zone, we must swiftly pursue the additional relocation of other public institutions or companies that have long been under consideration." Additionally, the President visited Busan and South Gyeongsang Province four times over the past month. A ruling party official commented, "The President's visit to Busan has raised expectations among Busan citizens regarding the relocation of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries." <<> In response to these actions by the government and ruling party, the People Power Party criticized them as "vote-buying with the budget." The argument is that while budgets must be finalized and executed through National Assembly deliberation, the Democratic Party, holding a majority, has effectively declared it will "spend the budget as it pleases" ahead of the elections. <<> People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon told this newspaper, "The national budget is not the exclusive property of any particular party or political force, but the people's tax money," calling it "irresponsible politics that show off by handing out people's tax money, which is not their own, and ultimately burden them with a tax bombshell." He described it as "a dangerous declaration of intent to use power for elections," urging "wise voters to put a stop to it." <<> The Democratic Party is also emphasizing the "argument for regime stability," citing the soaring stock market as a government achievement. The KOSPI index closed at a record high of 8788.38 points on June 1. On May 29, leader Chung Cheong-rae said, "Those who have profited from the KOSPI rise or feel pleased looking at their stock accounts, please vote for the Democratic Party." Since President Lee was party leader, the Democratic Party has focused on winning over the 14 million individual stock investors by pushing for the abolition of the financial investment income tax and amendments to the Commercial Act. <<> In response, the People Power Party is countering by emphasizing high prices, the jeonse and monthly rental housing crisis, and tax increases. On June 1, leader Jang Dong-hyuk posted on Facebook, "Only 20% of stocks have risen in the market," adding, "They don't even look at the grievances of the people who invested in the 80% that fell." Floor leader Song Eon-seok said, "The exchange rate has been stuck in the 1,500 won range for a long time, and prices are rising accordingly, with a bowl of samgyetang costing 20,000 won," questioning, "The ruling party is popping champagne for the KOSPI 8000, but how are the people's wallets doing?" <<> Amidst this, the People Power Party has revived the issues of the withdrawal of the indictment against President Lee and the abandonment of the appeal in the Daejang-dong case. On June 1, the People Power Party launched an online national petition campaign related to the Ministry of Justice's extension of the suspension period for Prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who investigated the Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case involving President Lee. The People Power Party stated, "This ultimately means they intend to 'cancel the trial' of President Lee's case." <<> The People Power Party is also fiercely attacking the recent release on bail of Jeong Young-hak and Jeong Min-yong, members of the Daejang-dong cartel. All individuals involved in the Daejang-dong case have been released, and with the prosecution abandoning the appeal in the Daejang-dong case, it has become impossible to recover the hundreds of billions of won in profits. (민주당 정청래 대표는 이날 충남 천안에서 열린 당 중앙선거대책위원회 회의에서 “예산은 이재명 정부에서 편성해 민주당이 국회에서 통과시킨다”며 “힘 있는 여당, 이재명 정부의 안정적인 국정 운영을 위해 기호 1번에 투표해달라”고 했다. 정 대표는 지난 29일 충남 홍성군 유세에선 “(정부·여당이) 예산 폭탄을 내려 홍성을 눈부시게 성장시키겠다”고 했다.)
